title.en: Watch: Moment 64-year-old Nepali woman is found alive in mud-buried home
title.zh: 观看：64岁尼泊尔妇女被发现在被泥土掩埋的家中仍生还的瞬间

summary.en: Chandika Shrestha was airlifted to hospital after spending more than 10 days in her partially buried house.
summary.zh: 钱迪卡·什雷斯塔在部分被掩埋的家中度过了10多天后，被空运送往医院。

body.en:
More than 10 days after a wall of ice, rock and mud tore through a Himalayan valley in Nepal, rescuers continue to find survivors.

Chandika Shrestha, a 64-year-old woman, was discovered alive on the fourth floor of her partially buried house in the Nuwakot district by Nepal's Armed Police Force on 5 September, according to Reuters.
body.zh: 尼泊尔喜马拉雅山谷的冰墙、岩石和泥土被撕裂十多天后，救援人员仍在继续寻找幸存者。 据路透社报道，尼泊尔武装警察部队于 9 月 5 日在努瓦科特地区部分掩埋的房屋四楼发现了 64 岁妇女钱迪卡·什雷斯塔 (Chandika Shrestha)，她还活着。

reflection.en: In the midst of overwhelming natural disaster, the story of Chandika Shrestha's survival after 10 days offers a powerful testament to resilience. Psalm 46:1 reminds us that even when the earth gives way, God remains our refuge and strength, a source of help readily available in times of crisis.
reflection.zh: 在压倒性的自然灾害中，钱迪卡·什雷斯塔在被掩埋10天后幸存下来的故事，有力地证明了生命的韧性。诗篇46:1提醒我们，即使大地动摇，雅伟仍是我们的避难所和力量，是在危机时刻随时可得的帮助。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Flights halted as volcanic ash spreads across parts of Indonesia
title.zh: 火山灰蔓延印尼部分地区，航班停飞

summary.en: Mount Anak Krakatau has been erupting since late on Friday, creating airport chaos. Indonesia's Soekarno-Hatta International Airport has suspended flights due to volcanic ash from the ongoing eruption of Mount Anak Krakatau. The suspension has affected 33 flights, including several international flights.
summary.zh: 自周五晚间以来，喀拉喀托之子火山持续喷发，造成机场混乱。印尼苏加诺-哈达国际机场因喀拉喀托之子火山持续喷发产生的火山灰而暂停航班。此次暂停已影响33个航班，包括数个国际航班。

body.en:
Indonesia's Soekarno-Hatta International Airport has suspended ‌flights due to ‌volcanic ash from the ongoing eruption of Mount Anak Krakatau.

The ⁠suspension until 9.30am on Sunday (12.30pm AEST), extends a halt that has affected 33 flights, including several international flights, ⁠Indonesia's ‌transportation ministry said on Instagram.

The suspension, extending a halt that had been scheduled until 5.30am local time, has affected 33 flights, including several international flights, Indonesia's transportation ministry said.

Mount Anak Krakatau has erupted ‌since late on Friday, with volcanic ash detected at the airport early on Sunday, the ministry said in a ‌statement.

Mount Anak Krakatau has erupted several times since 2018, when a major eruption caused the volcano's southwestern sector to collapse, dramatically reducing its size and creating a tsunami that left hundreds dead and tens of thousands injured.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The current eruption event is the fifth since 2020. None have been as damaging as the 2018 eruption.

The disaster mitigation agency said on Saturday there was no imminent risk of tsunami from the volcano.

Dispersal of volcanic ash has disrupted activities in Lampung province in Indonesia's Sumatra island and Banten province on Java, said Berton Panjaitan, a spokesperson for Indonesia's disaster mitigation agency, BNPB.

"BNPB urges the public to remain calm while increasing vigilance. In the event of ashfall, people are advised to wear masks and eye protection, reduce outdoor activities, cover water sources and exercise caution when driving, as volcanic ash can reduce visibility," he said.

Several schools cancelled activities on Saturday with students and residents suffering eye irritation from the ash, while fishermen cancelled their fishing trips due to the eruption, local media outlet Kompas reported.

body.zh: 由于阿纳克喀拉喀托火山持续喷发产生火山灰，印度尼西亚苏加诺-哈达国际机场已暂停航班。 印度尼西亚交通部在 Instagram 上表示，航班暂停时间将延长至周日上午 9 点 30 分（澳大利亚东部标准时间中午 12 点 30 分），这影响了 33 架航班，其中包括几架国际航班。 印度尼西亚交通部表示，此次停飞将原定的停飞时间延长至当地时间凌晨 5 点 30 分，影响了 33 架航班，其中包括几架国际航班。 该部在一份声明中表示，阿纳克喀拉喀托火山自周五晚些时候开始喷发，周日早些时候在机场发现了火山灰。 自 2018 年以来，阿纳克喀拉喀托火山已喷发数次，当时的一次大喷发导致火山西南部塌陷，火山面积急剧缩小，并引发海啸，造成数百人死亡、数万人受伤。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 此次火山喷发是 2020 年以来的第五次火山喷发。没有一次火山喷发像 2018 年火山喷发那样具有破坏性。 救灾机构周六表示，火山不会引发海啸。 印度尼西亚减灾机构 BNPB 发言人 Berton Panjaitan 表示，火山灰的扩散扰乱了印度尼西亚苏门答腊岛楠榜省和爪哇岛万丹省的活动。 他说：“BNPB敦促公众保持冷静，同时提高警惕。一旦发生火山灰，建议人们戴上口罩和护目镜，减少户外活动，遮盖水源，驾驶时小心谨慎，因为火山灰会降低能见度。” 据当地媒体《罗盘》报道，周六，几所学校取消了活动，学生和居民的眼睛因火山灰而受到刺激，渔民也因火山喷发而取消了钓鱼活动。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The eruption of Mount Anak Krakatau has grounded flights and disrupted travel plans for many. In moments of natural chaos, when the earth itself seems to shift, we can remember that Yahweh is our refuge and strength. He remains a steadfast presence amidst the unpredictable forces of nature.

title.en: US envoys meet Putin in Moscow for Ukraine talks
title.zh: 美代表抵达莫斯科，为乌克兰会谈做准备

summary.en: Two US envoys, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, have arrived in Moscow to hold talks aimed at accelerating efforts to end the war in Ukraine. They are expected to present a proposal to end the conflict before traveling to Kyiv on Sunday.
summary.zh: 美国特使史蒂夫·维特科夫和贾里德·库什纳已抵达莫斯科，旨在加速结束乌克兰战争的会谈。他们预计将在周日前往基辅之前提出一项结束冲突的提议。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump's top negotiators have met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow, as efforts to end the war in Ukraine gather pace.

Footage released by the Kremlin showed Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner being greeted by Putin, who said the current situation "is not so easy".

Witkoff thanked Putin for agreeing with Ukraine to halt strikes on each other's capitals for three days. On Sunday the envoys will travel to Kyiv for more talks - their first such visit to Ukraine's capital.

On Friday, Trump said Witkoff and Kushner were "bringing with them a proposal to end the war". So far, efforts by the US and its allies to broker a peace deal have failed.

At Saturday's talks in the Kremlin, Putin also said that "whatever happens, such contacts are undoubtedly always useful". He also thanked Trump for his peacemaking efforts.

He told the envoys that he was "comfortable" working with them, adding: "Of course on our side there is quite a high level of trust during this work."

The talks – held behind closed doors in Putin's official residence in the heart of the Russian capital – lasted for three hours, according to Russian state media.

Details are still emerging, but Putin adviser Yuri Ushakov described the talks as "constructive, extremely frank".

"The talks were not limited to an exchange of views on resolving the Ukrainian crisis - economic issues and potential major, mutually beneficial Russian-American projects were discussed in considerable detail," he said.

Ushakov also said "note was made of the Russian army's tangible advances in the combat zone" and that there was acknowledgement that talks needed to address "the root causes of the conflict".

Despite an escalation of Russian missile and drone strikes on Ukrainian cities including Kyiv, Russian ground forces have made very slow advances for most of the conflict, incurring enormous casualties. Russia still controls about one-fifth of Ukrainian territory - areas that it seized back in 2022.

Zelensky said earlier on Saturday that he had spoken to the envoys, who have "already begun working with the Russian side today".

"The plan for tomorrow's diplomatic engagements in Kyiv, involving the US team, has been approved. We are waiting for Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner and are ready for a substantive conversation," he added.

"From now through the end of Saturday, as well as on Sunday and Monday, Ukraine is ready to refrain from strikes on Moscow, and we expect the Russians to do the same regarding Kyiv."

Russian state media reported that Putin had ordered a halt to strikes on Kyiv for three days due to the US visit.

In televised remarks, Putin said Russia had not agreed to a ceasefire for the rest of Ukraine outside of the capital.

body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的两名高级特使在周末举行会谈之前抵达莫斯科，会谈旨在加速结束乌克兰战争的努力。 史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳定于周六抵达俄罗斯首都，在那里举行会谈，然后周日前往基辅与乌克兰进行讨论。 特朗普周五告诉记者，两人“带来了结束战争的提议”。迄今为止，美国及其盟国斡旋和平协议的努力未能取得突破。 美国新闻媒体 Axios 报道称，美国特使将分别会见俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基。 照片中威特科夫和库什纳在莫斯科伏努科沃机场降落后受到俄罗斯外交官基里尔·德米特里耶夫的迎接。 航班跟踪数据显示，一架美国政府飞机从芬兰赫尔辛基起飞，当天早些时候从美国飞往那里。 自特朗普重返办公室以来，这两位特使已多次前往莫斯科，但周日将是他们首次访问基辅。过去 18 个月，乌克兰代表团参加了在美国举行的会谈。 泽连斯基周六表示，在他计划与美国会晤之前，俄罗斯连夜对基辅和鲍里斯波尔的机场发动了“示威性”袭击。 乌克兰总统补充道：“显然，俄罗斯对机场的袭击是对美方可能使用飞机前往乌克兰并降落在基辅机场或鲍里斯波尔机场的讨论和准备的反应。” 自2022年2月俄罗斯发动全面入侵以来，乌克兰领空一直被关闭。 泽连斯基周五表示，他将在特使访问期间保证俄罗斯领空的安全，并呼吁俄罗斯为乌克兰做同样的事情。 他还表示，俄罗斯夜间对第聂伯罗地区一座民用建筑的袭击造成四人死亡，五人受伤。 威特科夫和库什纳访问莫斯科仅一周多前，中央情报局局长约翰·拉特克利夫罕见地访问了俄罗斯首都。 华盛顿或克里姆林宫没有对讨论的内容发表正式评论。特朗普上周发表讲话称这次会议是“半例行公事”。 去年，美国、乌克兰和俄罗斯分别表示，在美国斡旋的一系列谈判之后，结束战争的协议即将达成。 欧洲盟国也在巴黎举行了会谈，但讨论最终没有取得突破而结束。交战双方在乌克兰领土和安全保障等问题上仍存在重大分歧。 近几个月来，随着战斗仍在继续，俄罗斯和乌克兰都加强了空袭。 乌克兰表示，由于缺乏拦截器，它很难击退袭击......

reflection.en: As US envoys arrive in Moscow carrying a proposal to end the war in Ukraine, we are reminded of the blessedness of peacemakers. May their efforts be guided by wisdom and a genuine desire for reconciliation, reflecting the hope for peace that transcends conflict.
reflection.zh: 随着美国特使抵达莫斯科，并带着结束乌克兰战争的提议，我们被提醒那些制造和平的人是有福的。愿他们的努力得到智慧和真正和解的愿望的指引，反映出超越冲突的和平希望。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

reflection.zh: 斧头袭击事件造成三人生命垂危，这则新闻令人警醒，它提醒我们暴力的破坏性本质。耶稣说：“凡动刀的，必死在刀下”，这揭示了一个严峻的现实：暴力只会滋生更多的暴力，将个人和社区卷入伤害的循环。愿我们为伤者祈求医治，并为远离此类毁灭性道路祈祷。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: 'He was a lifeline' - Families at a loss after Haitian caregivers let go in US
title.zh: “他是一条生命线”——海地护理人员在美国失业后，家庭陷入困境

summary.en: Haitian immigrants make up a large portion of the already overburdened home-care workforce.
summary.zh: 海地移民占了本已不堪重负的家庭护理劳动力的很大一部分。

body.en:
Long Island mother-of-two Linda Mancuso has been "praying on a daily basis" that her disabled son's Haitian caregiver will be able to come back to work.

It was "horrifying," she says, when Jean, who had a temporary work permit, was laid off from work at the end of July from his position at a nonprofit supporting individuals with developmental and intellectual disabilities. Her son Michael is a 5ft 10in, nonverbal 23-year-old.

"Showering, sleeping, eating, tying his shoes - Michael can't tie his shoes - I mean, there's so much hands-on involvement, and Jean did all of that," she says.

Mancuso was a ball of nerves when she finally agreed to send Michael to residential care, at the age of 19, calling it "the hardest thing I've ever had to do".

But Michael lost that lifeline weeks ago, when his employer had to lay Jean off along with 18 other Haitians.

Their temporary protected status (TPS) - which allows eligible foreign nationals from unsafe countries to work in the US - had expired.

The Trump administration first announced in June 2025 that it would be removing the TPS for Haitians, and the ensuing legal battle went all the way to the Supreme Court.

But America's top judges ruled in favour of the administration, paving the way for 350,000 Haitians to lose their status at the end of July.

The stripping of that status meant that holders can no longer legally work in the US and are at risk of deportation.

The healthcare industry, with a robust Haitian workforce, has been hit particularly hard - with legions of employers forced to fire TPS holders who work directly with patients.

Trump cancelled TPS amid a wave of measures restricting immigration, a central plank of his successful 2024 election campaign.

Immigration was one of the top concerns for voters in that election and, in Long Island, both counties decisively backed Trump.

More than a dozen countries have had their TPS terminated in Trump's second term and Haitians make up nearly a third of all TPS recipients affected.

Haiti numbers among the top five countries from which immigrants in the direct-care workforce come, says Kezia Scales, vice-president of policy and research at the Paraprofessional Healthcare Institute.

The industry was already under-staffed and waitlists for many care services - from home health aides to assisted living - were already long.

"We simply do not have enough people in our domestic market, when you exclude immigrants, to fill those jobs," she tells BBC News.

National advocacy groups are campaigning for policies that would strengthen the long-term workforce - including ones that "would expand legal pathways for international caregivers".

When asked about the impact of TPS termination, a spokesperson for the Department of Homeland Security told the BBC...
body.zh: 长岛两个孩子的母亲琳达·曼库索一直在“每天祈祷”她残疾儿子的海地保姆能够重返工作岗位。 她说，当持有临时工作许可证的吉恩在一家支持发育障碍和智力障碍人士的非营利组织于七月底被解雇时，她说这“令人震惊”。她的儿子迈克尔身高 5 英尺 10 英寸，23 岁，不会说话。 “洗澡、睡觉、吃饭、系鞋带——迈克尔不会系鞋带——我的意思是，有太多的动手参与，而琼做了所有这些，”她说。 当迈克尔 19 岁时，曼库索最终同意将他送往寄养院，曼库索非常紧张，她称这是“我做过的最艰难的事情”。 但几周前，迈克尔失去了这条生命线，当时他的雇主不得不解雇让和其他 18 名海地人。 他们的临时保护身份（TPS）——允许来自不安全国家的合格外国人在美国工作——已经过期。 特朗普政府于 2025 年 6 月首次宣布将取消海地人的 TPS，随后的法律纠纷一直打到了最高法院。 但美国最高法官做出了有利于政府的裁决，为 7 月底 35 万海地人失去身份铺平了道路。 剥夺这一身份意味着持有人不能再在美国合法工作，并面临被驱逐出境的风险。 海地劳动力充足的医疗保健行业受到的打击尤其严重，大批雇主被迫解雇直接与患者打交道的 TPS 持有者。 特朗普在一系列限制移民的措施中取消了 TPS，这是他成功 2024 年竞选的核心内容。 移民是那次选举中选民最关心的问题之一，在长岛，两个县都坚决支持特朗普。 在特朗普第二任期内，已有十多个国家终止了 TPS，其中海地人占所有受影响 TPS 受益者的近三分之一。 专业医疗保健研究所政策与研究副总裁凯齐亚·斯卡尔斯 (Kezia Scales) 表示，海地是直接护理劳动力中移民来源最多的五个国家之一。 该行业已经人手不足，许多护理服务（从家庭健康助手到辅助生活）的等候名单已经很长。 “当你排除移民时，我们的国内市场根本没有足够的人来填补这些职位，”她告诉英国广播公司新闻。 国家倡导团体正在争取加强长期劳动力的政策，包括“扩大国际护理人员的法律途径”的政策。 当被问及 TPS 终止的影响时，国土安全部发言人告诉 BBC...

reflection.en: The story of Jean, a Haitian caregiver whose temporary work permit expired, leaving a disabled young man without essential daily support, reveals the precariousness faced by many immigrant workers. These individuals are often the 'lifeline' for families, providing critical care that enables others to live with dignity. Their vulnerability, however,...
reflection.zh: 故事讲述了海地护理人员让（Jean）的临时工作许可到期，导致一名残疾青年失去基本日常支持，这揭示了许多移民工人面临的困境。这些人往往是家庭的“生命线”，提供关键的护理，使他人能够有尊严地生活。然而，他们的脆弱性却凸显了一个系统性问题：基本劳动者得不到保护，而他们所照顾的人则陷入困境。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Majority Russian-speaking city in Ukraine considers language ban in the arts
title.zh: 乌克兰俄语人口占多数的城市考虑禁止艺术中使用俄语

summary.en: Ukraine's third-largest city, Odesa, is deciding this week whether to ban Russian-language content in music and literature in public spaces. This proposal is significant as Odesa is overwhelmingly Russian-speaking, though everyday usage would remain unaffected. Ukrainian is the sole state language.
summary.zh: 乌克兰第三大城市敖德萨本周将决定是否禁止在公共场所使用俄语音乐和文学作品。该提议意义重大，因为敖德萨绝大多数人口讲俄语，但禁令仅影响公共场所，日常俄语使用不受影响。乌克兰语是唯一的国家语言。

body.en:
Ukraine's third-biggest city Odesa will decide this week whether to back a controversial plan to ban the Russian language in the arts.

The proposal being considered by councillors in Odesa on the Black Sea coast aims to add to existing restrictions on Russian imposed by national legislation.

It is particularly significant because Odesa is overwhelmingly Russian-speaking, although the ban would only affect public spaces and everyday usage of Russian would remain unaffected.

For millions of Ukrainians, Russian is their first language including many of the troops defending the country in its war with Russia. But Ukrainian is the only state language and spoken by the majority, and some see Russian as a tool of Russian influence.

The proposal in Odesa, which is targeted daily by Russian drone and missile strikes, calls for a complete halt to Russian-language content in music and literature, in streets, parks, public institutions and state-run arts and entertainment venues. It would also recommend a ban in privately owned spaces.

In a city famous for Russian-language writers and musicians, it has provoked strong passions.

The ban would extend in public spaces to old Odesa songs almost universally known throughout the former Soviet Union. All Russian-language books would be removed from display in public libraries. Currently, they can be shown, but not prominently.

"The Russian language is a weapon of Russia, and we need to try to fix that," says Odesa lawyer Artem Kartashov, who has advised local authorities on an official programme to "decolonise" the city of its historic Russian legacy.

"With Russian-speaking music and other things, Russians try to deconstruct Ukrainian identity and influence especially young people, because they grow up in a Russian-speaking environment."

But comic actor Borys Barsky, one of Odesa's best-known entertainers, says: "Russian isn't [only] the language of Putin, it's the language of [writers like] Dostoyevsky and Bulgakov.

"Who benefits from setting people against other people who love Ukraine just as deeply, only love it in a different language? Only Putin benefits from this."

Russian President Vladimir Putin has often referred to what he falsely describes as repression of the Russian-speaking minority in Ukraine as one of his justifications for launching his invasion of the country.

Russian and Ukrainian are closely related, but distinct in many ways. Many in Ukraine speak a mixture of the two, known as surzhyk .

Russian is the native language of President Volodymyr Zelensky, which he used often in his election campaign but has since used only Ukrainian in public.

But a 2019 law requires use of Ukrainian in many public and professional contexts including education, public services and customer...
body.zh: 乌克兰第三大城市敖德萨将于本周决定是否支持一项有争议的禁止艺术领域使用俄语的计划。 黑海沿岸敖德萨的议员们正在审议的这项提案旨在增加国家立法对俄罗斯人施加的现有限制。 这一点尤其重要，因为敖德萨绝大多数人讲俄语，尽管该禁令只会影响公共场所，俄语的日常使用不会受到影响。 对于数百万乌克兰人来说，俄语是他们的第一语言，其中包括许多在与俄罗斯的战争中保卫国家的军队。但乌克兰语是唯一的官方语言，大多数人都使用乌克兰语，有些人将俄语视为俄罗斯影响力的工具。 敖德萨每天都成为俄罗斯无人机和导弹袭击的目标，该提案呼吁完全停止在音乐和文学、街道、公园、公共机构以及国营艺术和娱乐场所使用俄语内容。它还建议禁止私人拥有的空间。 在这座以俄语作家和音乐家而闻名的城市，它激起了强烈的热情。 该禁令将在公共场所扩大到在前苏联几乎家喻户晓的敖德萨老歌。所有俄语书籍都将不再在公共图书馆展出。目前，它们可以显示，但不显眼。 敖德萨律师阿特姆·卡尔塔绍夫（Artem Kartashov）表示：“俄语是俄罗斯的武器，我们需要努力解决这个问题。”他曾就一项官方计划向当地政府提供建议，以使这座城市的俄罗斯历史遗产“去殖民化”。 “通过俄语音乐和其他东西，俄罗斯人试图解构乌克兰人的身份并影响尤其是年轻人，因为他们是在俄语环境中长大的。” 但敖德萨最著名的艺人之一、喜剧演员鲍里斯·巴尔斯基表示：“俄语不仅是普京的语言，也是陀思妥耶夫斯基和布尔加科夫等作家的语言。 “让人们与其他同样深爱乌克兰、只是用不同语言爱它的人作对，这对谁有利？只有普京能从中受益。” 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京经常提到他错误地描述的对乌克兰俄语少数民族的镇压，作为他入侵该国的理由之一。 俄语和乌克兰语密切相关，但在许多方面都有所不同。许多乌克兰人混合使用两种语言，称为苏日克语。 俄语是总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基的母语，他在竞选活动中经常使用俄语，但此后在公共场合只使用乌克兰语。 但 2019 年的一项法律要求在许多公共和专业环境中使用乌克兰语，包括教育、公共服务和客户……

reflection.en: In Odesa, a city where Russian is the primary language for many, council members are considering a ban on Russian-language arts in public spaces. This decision navigates the complex intersection of national identity, cultural expression, and the lived reality of its citizens. The pursuit of peace and understanding requires careful consideration of such...
reflection.zh: 在敖德萨这座许多居民以俄语为母语的城市，市议员们正在考虑禁止在公共场所使用俄语艺术作品。这一决定关乎国家认同、文化表达以及市民的真实生活体验之间的复杂交集。寻求和平与理解需要审慎地考量这些深刻的议题。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: US envoys have a new idea to end the Russia-Ukraine war. Now they're heading to Kyiv
title.zh: 美代表或有新想法结束俄乌战争，正前往基辅

summary.en: Both Russia and Ukraine have agreed to halt strikes on their respective capitals for three days so that negotiations can continue. US envoys proposed a "number of ideas" on how to end the Ukraine war in "frank" talks with Russian president Vladimir Putin in the Kremlin late Saturday, Moscow said, ahead of their first...
summary.zh: 为使谈判得以继续，俄罗斯和乌克兰均同意在三天内停止对各自首都的袭击。据莫斯科称，美国特使周六晚间在克里姆林宫与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京进行了“坦诚”会谈，提出了结束乌克兰战争的“若干想法”，随后他们将首次访问基辅。

body.en:
US envoys proposed a "number of ideas" on how to end the Ukraine war in "frank" talks with Russian president Vladimir Putin in the Kremlin late Saturday, Moscow said, ahead of their first trip to Kyiv.

US President Donald Trump's business partner Steve Witkoff and son-in-law Jared Kushner met Putin for more than three hours, the Kremlin said, as Washington tries to revive negotiations to end Europe's worst conflict since WWII.

Their visit to Moscow comes after the war — which has killed hundreds of thousands and forced millions to flee their homes — escalated this summer. It also follows a visit last month to Moscow by the director of the CIA.

Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov called the talks "extremely frank", saying the Americans "put forward a number of ideas on possible routes to a settlement", but did not elaborate.

The Russian side told the Americans that Moscow was "confident" it could achieve its military goals of seizing the rest of eastern Ukraine, Ushakov added.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

It was Kushner and Witkoff's eighth visit to Moscow during the war — but it will be their first in the Ukrainian capital, hit by deadly Russian strikes throughout the war.

Both Russia and Ukraine have vowed not to strike each other's capitals for three days to allow for the negotiations to take place.

In televised comments before the talks, Putin said Russia would ensure the safety of the envoys in Kyiv — a city Moscow has pounded with deadly strikes throughout the war.

"We will do everything that depends on us to ensure the safety of the negotiation process and mediators such as yourselves," Putin told Witkoff and Kushner.

A day earlier, Kyiv said Russia had struck the headquarters of its SBU security services in the city's historic centre with a drone.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he was expecting the envoys on Sunday, and it was unclear how they would get to Kyiv by then.

Ukrainian airspace has been closed since Moscow launched the war in February 2022, and visiting leaders have been arriving by train.

Early Sunday, Putin had thanked Trump for persisting in his efforts to end the war — launched by Russia in 2022 — despite it being "not simple".

Of the envoys' trip to Kyiv, he said: "No matter what happens next, contacts of this kind are undoubtedly always beneficial."

Moscow occupied large swathes of eastern and southern Ukraine. Putin has insisted Moscow is intent on seizing the rest of east Ukraine.

Witkoff and Kushner arrived in Moscow after a summer of escalation that saw a drastic rise in civilian deaths on both sides.

Kyiv said Saturday that Russian strikes had killed 10...
body.zh: 莫斯科表示，在首次访问基辅之前，美国特使周六晚间在克里姆林宫与俄罗斯总统普京举行“坦诚”会谈，就如何结束乌克兰战争提出了“一些想法”。 克里姆林宫表示，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的商业伙伴史蒂夫·威特科夫和女婿贾里德·库什纳与普京会面了三个多小时，华盛顿正试图重启谈判，以结束欧洲自二战以来最严重的冲突。 他们对莫斯科的访问是在今年夏天战争升级之后进行的，这场战争已造成数十万人死亡，迫使数百万人逃离家园。此前，中央情报局局长上个月访问了莫斯科。 克里姆林宫助手尤里·乌沙科夫称会谈“极其坦率”，并称美国人“就可能的解决途径提出了一些想法”，但没有详细说明。 乌沙科夫补充说，俄罗斯方面告诉美国，莫斯科“有信心”能够实现夺取乌克兰东部其他地区的军事目标。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 这是库什纳和威特科夫在战争期间第八次访问莫斯科，但这将是他们第一次访问乌克兰首都，该国在整个战争期间遭受了俄罗斯的致命袭击。 俄罗斯和乌克兰都发誓三天内不会袭击对方的首都，以便进行谈判。 普京在会谈前的电视讲话中表示，俄罗斯将确保基辅特使的安全——莫斯科在整个战争期间对这座城市进行了致命的袭击。 普京对维特科夫和库什纳说：“我们将尽一切努力确保谈判进程和你们等调解人的安全。” 一天前，基辅表示，俄罗斯用无人机袭击了位于该市历史中心的 SBU 安全部门总部。 乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，他正在等待特使们周日的到来，目前尚不清楚他们届时将如何抵达基辅。 自莫斯科于 2022 年 2 月发动战争以来，乌克兰领空一直被关闭，来访的领导人都是乘火车抵达的。 周日早些时候，普京感谢特朗普坚持不懈地努力结束这场由俄罗斯于 2022 年发动的战争，尽管这场战争“并不简单”。 在谈到特使们的基辅之行时，他说：“无论接下来发生什么，这种接触无疑总是有益的。” 莫斯科占领了乌克兰东部和南部的大片地区。普京坚称莫斯科有意夺取乌克兰东部的其余地区。 维特科夫和库什纳在经历了一个夏天的冲突升级后抵达莫斯科，双方平民死亡人数急剧上升。 基辅周六表示，俄罗斯的空袭已造成 10 人死亡。

reflection.en: In the midst of ongoing conflict, a brief pause in hostilities for the sake of negotiation offers a glimmer of hope. Matthew 5:9 reminds us that those who work to reconcile and bring peace are blessed, reflecting the difficult but necessary work of diplomacy in war-torn regions.
reflection.zh: 在持续的冲突中，为谈判而暂时停火为人们带来了一线希望。《马太福音》5:9 提醒我们，那些致力于和解与带来和平的人是有福的，这恰恰反映了在饱受战争蹂躏的地区，外交工作是艰难但必要的。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Falling ceiling debris at Kennedy Center may mire debate over renovations
title.zh: 肯尼迪中心天花板坠落恐令翻新辩论陷入僵局

summary.en: Falling debris from a ceiling in the grand foyer of the John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts, following heavy rain, has temporarily closed the building and may complicate a debate over renovations that could lead to its demolition. Preservationists fear the incident will be used by the board to push for the...
summary.zh: 在暴雨过后，约翰·肯尼迪表演艺术中心宏伟门厅的天花板坠落碎片，导致该建筑暂时关闭，并可能使一场可能导致其被拆除的翻新辩论复杂化。保护主义者担心这一事件会被董事会用来推动关闭该建筑。

body.en: Preservationists worry board may seize on incident ‘to make the point that the whole thing needs to be shut down’ Falling debris from a ceiling in the grand foyer of the John F Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts may have complicated a battle over renovations of the Washington DC arts center that could result in the building being demolished. A portion of the ceiling collapsed on Friday evening after heavy rain swept through the area, prompting officials to temporarily close the Edward Durell Stone-designed building. No one was injured by the debris. Continue reading...

Preservationists fear this incident will be seized upon to justify demolition, rather than being part of a broader discussion that considers all viewpoints. Proverbs 18:17 reminds us that 'The first...
reflection.zh: 肯尼迪中心天花板碎片的坠落，虽然幸好无人受伤，却成为了关于该建筑未来一场更大辩论的焦点。保护主义者担心这一事件会被用来证明拆除的合理性，而不是作为更广泛讨论的一部分，考虑到所有观点。箴言18:17提醒我们：“先诉的显出理屈，后到的显出情真。”在任何辩论中，尤其是在对一个文化地标如此重大的问题上，倾听各方意见对于公正的结果至关重要。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Aviation faces hotter, stormier skies – and passengers might have to accept more disruption
title.zh: 航空业面临更炎热、风暴更频繁的天空——乘客可能不得不接受更多延误

summary.en: The aviation industry is increasingly facing disruptions due to intensifying climate change effects, leading to more flight delays and diversions. A recent example saw around 900 flights delayed at London's Heathrow and Gatwick airports due to severe thunderstorms, causing chaos for thousands of holiday travelers.
summary.zh: 航空业因气候变化加剧而面临日益增多的中断，导致航班延误和改道。最近的一个例子是，伦敦希思罗和盖特威克机场因强雷暴天气导致约900个航班延误，给数千名度假旅客造成混乱。

body.en:
As the country sweltered through one of the many heatwaves of a baking summer in late June, towering thunderclouds were gathering over the south of England and across much of northern Europe. It was a Saturday, and with the holiday season getting under way, thousands of passengers were heading to London's Heathrow and Gatwick airports to catch flights abroad. It was always going to be a very busy day.

What followed, however, was chaos for travellers. As air traffic controllers struggled to route aircraft around the storms, airspace became heavily congested and many planes due to fly were simply forced to wait on the ground. In the end, some 900 flights to and from both airports were delayed, some by up to 11 hours. Dozens more were cancelled. At airports across Europe, passengers expecting to fly into London also faced long waits and uncertainty.

The weather in the UK may now have cooled, and passengers may soon forget their experiences. But some within the industry believe what happened in June should be seen as a warning.

The timing in this case was clearly unlucky. But there are concerns that such incidents are only going to become more common as the effects of climate change mount up around the world and weather systems are likely to become increasingly unstable, making disruption more likely and adding to costs for airlines, airports and travellers.

Tim Atkinson, an airline risk consultant and former pilot, says the very crowded skies over the UK and northern Europe mean the region is particularly exposed.

He thinks there is a real risk, for example, that all of London's airports could be affected by storms at the same time, potentially with major consequences in the air and on the ground.

"We're going from the kind of weather activity which takes out an airport, and which the system kind of copes with… to a situation where, with very little predictability, it would be possible to lose all of the London airports from real-time operation quite swiftly and with little notice".

Such a scenario, he thinks, would make the disruption for passengers caused by the incident in June seem relatively minor – and could even put lives at risk. But how likely is it?

For controllers at National Air Traffic Services's (NATS) main control centre in Swanwick, Hampshire, thunderstorms are a major preoccupation. When I visit, it is a hot and humid day, there are ominous dark clouds in the sky, and heavy, thundery downpours are hitting the surrounding region.

In Terminal Control, the part of the building responsible for flights heading to or from airports in London and southern England, those same storm cells are being monitored continually. Their progress is tracked on large radar screens, while at the same time weather forecasts are carefully...
body.zh: 六月下旬，当这个国家经历了炎热夏季的众多热浪之一时，高耸的雷雨云正在英格兰南部和北欧大部分地区聚集。那是一个星期六，随着假期的到来，成千上万的乘客前往伦敦希思罗机场和盖特威克机场搭乘国外航班。这总是非常忙碌的一天。 然而，随之而来的是旅客的混乱。由于空中交通管制员努力引导飞机绕过风暴，空域变得严重拥堵，许多原定飞行的飞机被迫在地面等待。最终，大约 900 架次往返这两个机场的航班均被延误，有的延误长达 11 小时。还有数十个被取消。在欧洲各地的机场，预计飞往伦敦的乘客也面临着漫长的等待和不确定性。 英国的天气现在可能已经变冷，乘客可能很快就会忘记他们的经历。但一些业内人士认为，6月份发生的事情应该被视为一个警告。 这起案件的时机显然很不走运。但有人担心，随着气候变化的影响在世界各地加剧，天气系统可能变得越来越不稳定，此类事件只会变得更加普遍，从而更有可能造成干扰，并增加航空公司、机场和旅客的成本。 航空公司风险顾问兼前飞行员蒂姆·阿特金森表示，英国和北欧上空非常拥挤，意味着该地区尤其容易受到影响。 例如，他认为存在真正的风险，伦敦所有机场可能同时受到风暴影响，可能对空中和地面造成重大影响。 “我们正在从那种导致机场瘫痪、系统需要应对的天气活动转变为这样一种情况：在几乎没有可预测性的情况下，所有伦敦机场有可能在几乎没有通知的情况下很快就失去实时运行的能力”。 他认为，这种情况会使 6 月份的事件对乘客造成的干扰显得相对较小，甚至可能危及生命。但这种可能性有多大呢？ 对于位于汉普郡斯旺威克的国家空中交通服务 (NATS) 主控制中心的管制员来说，雷暴是他们最关心的问题。我去的时候，天气炎热潮湿，天空乌云密布，周围地区还​​下着倾盆大雨。 在航站楼控制中心（负责往返伦敦和英格兰南部机场的航班的大楼部分），这些风暴单元正在受到持续监控。他们的进展在大型雷达屏幕上被追踪，同时天气预报也被仔细地......

reflection.en: As climate change intensifies, the skies become less predictable, leading to significant disruptions like the 900 flight delays at London airports. In these moments of chaos and uncertainty, Psalm 46:1 reminds us that even when the earth is shaken, God remains our refuge and strength. We are called to find our ultimate security not in the stability of...
reflection.zh: 随着气候变化加剧，天空变得越来越不可预测，导致了严重的混乱，例如伦敦机场的900次航班延误。在这些混乱和不确定的时刻，《诗篇》46:1提醒我们，即使地动山摇，雅伟仍是我们的避难所和力量。我们被呼召将最终的安全寄托在全能者的坚定不移之上，而非系统的稳定性。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Three rescued from flooded tunnels, giving families renewed hope in Nepal
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水隧道救援：三名被困者获救，给家人带来新的希望

summary.en: Authorities reported that the latest man rescued from flooded tunnels in Nepal showed signs of mild hypothermia but had stable vital signs and no visible injuries, offering renewed hope to families.
summary.zh: 当局报告称，在尼泊尔被洪水淹没的隧道中获救的最新一名男子出现了轻度体温过低的迹象，但生命体征稳定，无明显外伤，这给家属带来了新的希望。

body.en:
A Chinese national was pulled alive from a tunnel in Nepal on Sunday, authorities said, 10 days after a wall of ice, rock and mud tore through a Himalayan valley, killing more than 1,300 people.

The Nepali army said Lu Haitao was rescued from inside a 225-metre tunnel at the Upper Trishuli-1 Hydropower Project.

He was the third person so far to be pulled out alive from various tunnels where authorities believe 900 people might be stuck after the August 26 collapse of a glacier on the upper reaches of the river.

On Saturday, rescue workers pulled two people from another tunnel at the Upper Trishuli 3A Hydropower Station on the same river.

The authorities said Lu had no visible injuries and his vitals were stable, but that he showed signs of mild hypothermia.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Footage shared by the Nepali army showed him being given emergency medical attention inside a helicopter, which took him to an army hospital.

He appeared exhausted and disoriented, with dried mud and dust on his skin and clothing. A uniformed medic with a stethoscope was seen checking him.

At least 1,344 people have been killed in Nepal in the floods that swept away houses, streets and schools in towns and villages near the border with China's Tibet, the disaster management authority said on Saturday. About 4,887 are still missing, including 583 foreign nationals, many of them pilgrims and trekkers.

As of Saturday, China said the death toll in Tibet was 31, with 531 others listed as missing, including foreign nationals, according to state media Xinhua. Some 261 foreign nationals remain missing in Tibet.

A woman, Chandika Kumari Shrestha, was also rescued from her home in Betrawati on Saturday, the Nepali army said. In an image shared by authorities, she is seen caked in mud inside a flooded underground structure as rescuers offer her water while working in a confined space filled with thick sludge.

At the Maithili Barrack in Nepal's Nuwakot district, families filled walls with posters showing loved ones believed to be trapped in the tunnels.

Among them was the image of Ishwor Poudel, the brother of 34-year-old Krishna Poudel. Ishwor has been a worker at the tunnel of the Hakubesi Hydroelectric Project for the past three years.

Krishna says he last heard from his brother on August 26, shortly after floodwaters tore through the valley.

"I spoke to him at 7.30am before he went into the tunnel for work. Around 11.30am, after the floods came down, I finally got through, and he told me: 'I'm trapped inside the tunnel.'"

The family has had no contact with him since, but remains hopeful. Survivors who escaped from the same tunnel told them that Ishwor was...
body.zh: 当局称，周日，一名中国公民从尼泊尔的一个隧道中被活活救出，十天前，冰墙、岩石和泥浆冲破喜马拉雅山谷，造成 1,300 多人死亡。 尼泊尔军方表示，陆海涛是从上特里舒里一号水电站项目一条225米长的隧道内获救的。 8 月 26 日，河流上游冰川崩塌，当局相信可能有 900 人被困，他是迄今为止第三位从各隧道中被生还的人。 周六，救援人员从同一条河上 Trishuli 3A 水电站的另一个隧道中救出了两人。 当局表示，卢没有明显受伤，生命体征稳定，但有轻度体温过低的迹象。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 尼泊尔军队分享的视频显示，他在直升机内接受紧急医疗救治，并被送往陆军医院。 他看上去精疲力尽、迷失方向，皮肤和衣服上沾满了干涸的泥土和灰尘。有人看到一名身穿制服的医生拿着听诊器对他进行检查。 尼泊尔灾害管理部门周六表示，洪水冲毁了尼泊尔与中国西藏边境附近城镇和村庄的房屋、街道和学校，造成至少 1,344 人死亡。仍有约 4,887 人失踪，其中包括 583 名外国人，其中许多人是朝圣者和徒步旅行者。 据官方媒体新华社报道，截至周六，中国称西藏死亡人数为 31 人，另有 531 人失踪，其中包括外国人。目前仍有约261名外国人在西藏失踪。 尼泊尔军方称，周六，一名名叫 Chandika Kumari Shrestha 的妇女也从贝特拉瓦蒂 (Betrawati) 的家中被救出。在当局分享的一张照片中，可以看到她在被淹没的地下建筑内沾满泥浆，救援人员在充满厚厚污泥的密闭空间内工作时为她提供水。 在尼泊尔努瓦科特地区的迈蒂利军营，许多家庭在墙上贴满了海报，海报上的亲人据信被困在隧道中。 其中包括 34 岁 Krishna Poudel 的兄弟 Ishwor Poudel 的照片。过去三年来，伊什沃尔一直是 Hakubesi 水力发电项目隧道的工人。 克里希纳说，他最后一次听到哥哥的消息是在 8 月 26 日，当时洪水冲垮了山谷。 “早上 7.30，他进入隧道工作之前，我和他进行了交谈。上午 11.30 左右，洪水退去后，我终于打通了，他告诉我：‘我被困在隧道里了。’” 此后，家人就再也没有与他联系过，但仍然充满希望。从同一条隧道逃出来的幸存者告诉他们，伊什沃是……

reflection.en: Ten days trapped, a wall of ice, rock, and mud, and the loss of over 1,300 lives – the disaster in Nepal is immense. Yet, the rescue of Lu Haitao, alive and stable after so long, is a powerful testament to resilience and the possibility of healing. It reminds us that even in the face of overwhelming devastation, Yahweh binds up the wounds of the...
reflection.zh: 被困十天，冰、岩石和泥浆的冲击，以及超过1300人的丧生——尼泊尔的灾难是巨大的。然而，陆海涛在如此长时间后被救出，生命体征稳定，有力地证明了韧性和治愈的可能性。这提醒我们，即使面对压倒性的毁灭，雅伟也医治伤心的人，并带来希望的曙光。

verse.textEn: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
verse.textZh: 他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。

title.en: Trump’s pique with UK could lead to favor to acolyte Milei over Falklands
title.zh: 特朗普对英国的不满可能导致他偏袒追随者米莱而非马尔维纳斯群岛

summary.en: Former US President Donald Trump has suggested he might back his Argentinian ally Javier Milei's claim to the disputed Falkland Islands, a move that could strain US-UK relations. Trump's past rhetoric, including declaring 'I am your retribution,' suggests a tendency towards vengeance.
summary.zh: 美国前总统唐纳德·特朗普暗示他可能支持他的阿根廷盟友哈维尔·米莱收复争议中的福克兰群岛的主张，此举可能加剧美英关系紧张。特朗普过去的言论，包括宣称‘我是你们的报复’，表明了他倾向于复仇。

body.en: US president suggests he might support his Argentinian ally’s drive to reclaim sovereignty of disputed islands Donald Trump has long embraced vengeance. “I am your retribution,” he declared to an admiring audience at the 2023 Conservative Political Action Conference (CPAC) as he commenced his march back to the White House. It is unlikely Argentina, and far-flung holdovers of the former British empire, were on the US president’s mind at the time. Continue reading...
body.zh: 美国总统暗示他可能会支持阿根廷盟友收回争议岛屿主权的努力唐纳德·特朗普长期以来一直热衷于复仇。 “我是你们的报应，”他在 2023 年保守党政治行动会议 (CPAC) 上开始返回白宫时向钦佩的观众宣布。当时美国总统不太可能考虑阿根廷和前大英帝国的遥远保留地。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news touches on a leader's past declaration of being 'retribution.' This echoes the human temptation to respond to perceived wrongs with vengeance. The ancient wisdom of Romans 12:21 calls us instead to 'overcome evil with good,' a path that seeks to break cycles of retaliation rather than perpetuate them.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻触及了一位领导人过去宣称自己是‘报复’。这呼应了人类以报复回应不公的诱惑。罗马书12章21节的古老智慧呼吁我们‘以善胜恶’，这条道路旨在打破报复的循环，而非延续它们。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: The unexpected way China is accused of exerting influence in the Pacific
title.zh: 中国被指控在太平洋施加影响的意想不到的方式

summary.en: As Palau again draws China's ire, its president has turned to Australia to help "diversify" its most significant economic contributor: tourism. The island nation, a Micronesian archipelago, is known for its stunning natural beauty and pristine coral reefs, which are central to its tourism-dependent economy.
summary.zh: 在帕劳再次惹恼中国之际，其总统已转向澳大利亚，寻求帮助“多元化”其最重要的经济支柱：旅游业。这个太平洋岛国以其迷人的自然风光和原始的珊瑚礁而闻名，这是其旅游业经济的核心。

body.en:
As our boat bobs along clear turquoise waters, the local operator hands us snorkelling masks. You don’t need them, though, to see a stunning coral reef and schools of vibrant fish surrounded by historic limestone islands.

In a nearby lake, we swim under the hot sun and among hundreds of jellyfish, some tickling our legs and arms. They’re harmless, Palau’s president Surangel Whipps Jr, had earlier assured us.

Whipps, fresh from hosting a highly charged Pacific Islands Forum, proudly points to the postcard landscape behind him: “This is my office”, he declares.

It’s in Palau, a Micronesian nation dotting the western Pacific, with a population of just 18,000, that China has triggered its sting. The reason: Palau is one of just 12 countries in the world to formally recognise Taiwan, a decision that has long angered Beijing, but its wrath was felt on the global stage this week.

Just days before 2,000 people were expected to converge on the island for the 55th Pacific Islands Forum leaders’ meeting, China issued a travel advisory to its residents, warning them of “theft” and “a dangerous local marine environment”.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Whipps said it was “unfortunate” that Beijing was “weaponising tourism”, an industry Palau is heavily reliant on. More than 40 per cent of its GDP comes from the tourism industry.

“We live in a free world. We should enjoy each other’s treasures and treat each other with respect, and I hope that the people in China see that,” Whipps said.

“Maybe [Chinese] leadership has a different opinion, but at the end of the day, we're all people of this one planet, and we care about each other.”

Palau’s ambassador to Taiwan Gaafar Uherbelau says this isn’t the first time China has used tourism to respond to diplomatic spats.

“We saw a peak in Chinese tourists that came in, and then all of a sudden we saw a plunge due to this ongoing tension that we got caught in between,” Uherbelau says.

In 2015, Palau boasted more than 165,000 visitors from around the world, and more than 91,000 of them came from China alone. Last year, total visitors were just two-thirds of that number, recording just 65,558 people.

But in November 2017, the Chinese government ended chartered flights to the island and ordered tour operators to stop selling package tours to Palau, in what was unofficially known as a “tourism ban”. By 2019, Palau’s total visitor numbers had halved to just 85,000 and tourism from China plummeted by 63 per cent.

Despite the...
body.zh: 当我们的船沿着清澈碧绿的海水航行时，当地经营者递给我们浮潜面罩。不过，您不需要它们就能看到令人惊叹的珊瑚礁和被历史悠久的石灰岩岛屿包围的充满活力的鱼群。 在附近的一个湖里，我们在烈日下游泳，周围有数百只水母，有些水母在逗我们的腿和手臂发痒。帕劳总统小苏兰吉尔·惠普斯早些时候向我们保证，它们是无害的。 惠普斯刚刚主持完一场气氛紧张的太平洋岛屿论坛，他自豪地指着身后明信片上的风景：“这是我的办公室”，他宣称。 中国在帕劳发动了攻击，帕劳是一个位于西太平洋的密克罗尼西亚国家，人口只有 18,000 人。原因是：帕劳是世界上仅有的 12 个正式承认台湾的国家之一，这一决定长期以来一直激怒北京，但本周全球舞台上也感受到了中国的愤怒。 就在预计将有 2000 人聚集在岛上参加第 55 届太平洋岛屿论坛领导人会议的前几天，中国向居民发布了旅行警告，警告他们“盗窃”和“当地危险的海洋环境”。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 惠普斯表示，北京“将旅游业武器化”是“不幸的”，而帕劳严重依赖旅游业。其GDP的40%以上来自旅游业。 “我们生活在一个自由的世界。我们应该享受彼此的财富并相互尊重，我希望中国人民看到这一点，”惠普斯说。 “也许（中国）领导层有不同的看法，但归根结底，我们都是这个星球上的人民，我们互相关心。” 帕劳驻台湾大使加法尔·乌赫贝劳表示，这并不是中国第一次利用旅游业来回应外交争端。 乌赫贝劳说：“我们看到中国游客数量达到了高峰，但由于夹在中间的持续紧张局势，我们突然看到了游客数量的大幅下降。” 2015年，帕劳接待了来自世界各地的游客超过165,000人次，其中仅来自中国的游客就超过91,000人次。去年，游客总数仅为 65,558 人，仅为这一数字的三分之二。 但2017年11月，中国政府终止了飞往该岛的包机，并命令旅行社停止销售前往帕劳的旅行团，这被非正式地称为“旅游禁令”。到 2019 年，帕劳的游客总数减少了一半，仅为 85,000 人次，来自中国的游客锐减 63%。 尽管...

reflection.en: Palau's president is navigating a delicate geopolitical situation, seeking to diversify his nation's economy away from over-reliance on a single partner due to external pressures. This mirrors the wisdom of not putting all one's eggs in one basket, especially when external forces can disrupt the primary source of support.
reflection.zh: 帕劳总统正处于一个微妙的地缘政治环境中，由于外部压力，他试图实现国家经济多元化，摆脱对单一伙伴的过度依赖。这呼应了“不要把所有鸡蛋放在一个篮子里”的智慧，尤其是在外部力量可能扰乱主要支持来源的情况下。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Why many Syrians feel Assad death sentence isn't enough
title.zh: 为何许多叙利亚人认为阿萨德的死刑判决不够

summary.en: In July, a Syrian court sentenced former dictator Bashar Assad to death for crimes against his own people. However, after 14 years of civil war, many survivors are demanding more in terms of transitional justice.
summary.zh: 今年7月，一家叙利亚法院判处前独裁者巴沙尔·阿萨德因危害本国人民罪而死刑。然而，在经历了14年的内战后，许多幸存者要求在过渡司法方面有更多的作为。

body.en:
In July, a Syrian court sentenced former dictator Bashar Assad to death for crimes against his own people. But after 14 years of civil war, many survivors are demanding more when it comes to transitional justice.

Huda Khayti often finds herself returning to the place where she lost almost everything. Khayti, a Syrian women's rights activist, survived a 2013 chemical weapons attack on the east Ghouta region by forces of the former Syrian dictator Bashar Assad. 

Her brother was killed by the bombs of the Assad regime and its allies. Her women's center was destroyed along with her home and in 2018, she had to leave her hometown of Douma — a major city in Ghouta — and flee to Idlib, a rebel stronghold in northern Syria.

Today, Khayti regularly visits her hometown, which is about 10 kilometers (about 6 miles) northeast of the country's capital, Damascus. Since the Assad regime was overthrown in late 2024, Khayti has traveled regularly between Idlib and Douma, where she's even working on opening a new women's center.

"Ghouta means so much to me emotionally," she told DW. But every time she returns there, she is also confronted with remnants of the civil war. "When I'm traveling through the country I see traces of war everywhere, so many houses and so much infrastructure destroyed. So much suffering. So much trauma."

Almost two years since the overthrow of the Assad regime,  Syria has started a process to examine the crimes of the regime in court. In mid-August a Damascus court sentenced Bashar Assad and other high-ranking members of his regime to death in absentia . Assad is currently living in Russia, where he fled after his government was overthrown. Many senior officials are also there or hiding elsewhere.

Among other things, Assad was found guilty of premeditated murder, torture and depriving individuals of their liberty. The court said these were war crimes and crimes against humanity.

"Of course, this conviction of Assad is a good thing," Khayti said. "Even if it's only on paper. Bashar Assad may have been convicted but he just continues to live his life in Russia — like so many other Syrian criminals who fled to Russia."

The court's conviction had a big impact in Syria anyway. "The verdict had a lot of echoes by people, they were so happy," said Lina Chawaf, a Syrian journalist, media expert and researcher at Harvard University's Center for Middle Eastern Studies. "Many media celebrated the verdict on the statement day as a victory and consider it as part of transitional justice."

Still, it remains unclear whether there will be any actual punishment following the conviction. Although Russia and Syria agreed on an extradition treaty in 2023, observers say it's unlikely Russia would send Assad, a long-time ally, back to Syria....
body.zh: 7月，叙利亚法院以针对本国人民的罪行判处前独裁者巴沙尔·阿萨德死刑。但经过 14 年的内战，许多幸存者对过渡时期司法提出了更多要求。 胡达·卡蒂 (Huda Khayti) 经常发现自己回到了几乎失去一切的地方。 2013 年，叙利亚前独裁者巴沙尔·阿萨德的军队对东古塔地区发动化学武器袭击，叙利亚妇女权利活动家卡伊蒂 (Khayti) 幸存下来。 她的兄弟被阿萨德政权及其盟友的炸弹炸死。她的妇女中心和她的家一起被摧毁，2018 年，她不得不离开家乡杜马（古塔的一个主要城市），逃到叙利亚北部叛军据点伊德利卜。 如今，海蒂定期回访她的家乡，该家乡位于该国首都大马士革东北约 10 公里（约 6 英里）处。自 2024 年底阿萨德政权被推翻以来，海蒂经常往返于伊德利卜和杜马之间，她甚至正在致力于在那里开设一个新的妇女中心。 “古塔在情感上对我来说意义重大，”她告诉德国之声。但每次她回到那里，她也面临着内战的残余。 “当我在这个国家旅行时，我到处都看到战争的痕迹，如此多的房屋和如此多的基础设施被毁。如此多的苦难。如此多的创伤。” 阿萨德政权被推翻近两年后，叙利亚已开始在法庭上审查该政权的罪行。八月中旬，大马士革法院缺席判处巴沙尔·阿萨德及其政权的其他高级成员死刑。阿萨德目前居住在俄罗斯，他在政府被推翻后逃离俄罗斯。许多高级官员也在那里或躲在其他地方。 除其他外，阿萨德被判犯有预谋谋杀、酷刑和剥夺个人自由的罪名。法院称这些都是战争罪和反人类罪。 “当然，阿萨德被定罪是一件好事，”海蒂说。 “即使只是在纸面上。巴沙尔·阿萨德可能已被定罪，但他只是继续在俄罗斯生活——就像许多其他逃往俄罗斯的叙利亚罪犯一样。” 无论如何，法院的判决对叙利亚产生了巨大影响。 “这一判决得到了很多人的响应，他们非常高兴，”叙利亚记者、媒体专家、哈佛大学中东研究中心研究员莉娜·查瓦夫(Lina Chawaf)说。 “许多媒体在声明日庆祝判决为胜利，并将其视为过渡司法的一部分。” 不过，目前尚不清楚定罪后是否会受到任何实际惩罚。尽管俄罗斯和叙利亚在 2023 年达成了引渡条约，但观察人士表示，俄罗斯不太可能将长期盟友阿萨德送回叙利亚。

reflection.en: The Syrian civil war has inflicted immense suffering, leaving survivors yearning for a justice that transcends mere punishment. The demand for 'transitional justice' reflects a deep need for accountability and healing, acknowledging that a legal sentence alone may not fully address the profound wounds left by years of conflict and oppression. This echoes...
reflection.zh: 叙利亚内战造成了巨大的苦难，幸存者渴望超越单纯惩罚的公正。对“过渡司法”的要求反映了对问责和疗愈的深切需求，承认单纯的法律判决可能无法完全弥合多年冲突和压迫留下的深刻创伤。这呼应了哈巴谷对破碎司法的哀叹，在那里，对真正公义和问责的呼喊与那些遭受如此毁灭的人们产生了共鸣。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: Outrage as Maltese tycoon acquitted in journalist's murder
title.zh: 震惊：马耳他巨头记者谋杀案无罪

summary.en: Maltese businessman Yorgen Fenech has been acquitted of complicity in the murder of journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia. The verdict, delivered nearly nine years after the attack, leaves the question of who ordered her death unresolved, sparking outrage from the public and the victim's family.
summary.zh: 马耳他商人尤尔根·费内赫被判无罪，此前他被指控共谋杀害记者达芙妮·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚。这起袭击事件发生近九年后，谁下令杀害她的问题仍未得到解答，这在公众和受害者家属中引发了愤怒。

body.en:
Maltese businessman Yorgen Fenech has been found not guilty of complicity to murder journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia. Almost nine years after the attack, the question of who ordered her death remains unanswered.

As Yorgen Fenech left the courthouse in Valletta on Wednesday evening, he was confronted by the furious crowd outside. The 44-year-old Maltese businessman pushed through, flanked by his security guards. Just minutes earlier, a jury had acquitted him of ordering the murder of the 53-year-old investigative journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia.

The verdict came as a shock to her family. Her son, Matthew Caruana Galizia, said it was a "terrible decision by the jurors that our country may never recover from." He later doubled down on his criticism, describing the verdict in a post on Facebook as "obscene" and saying: "Their decision flies in the face of all evidence, of all logic, of the truth."

Almost nine years after Caruana Galizia's murder, Malta is again confronted with the crucial question: Who was responsible for her death on October 16, 2017? The men who procured the bomb, placed it under the driver's seat and detonated it remotely have already been convicted . But the person who contracted them to do it has still not been legally identified.

For years, Fenech was considered to be the central figure in the investigations. His arrest on the morning of November 20, 2019, was like something out of a movie. His luxury yacht, Gio, had just left harbor when it was stopped by a Maltese military patrol boat. Fenech was arrested on board and subsequently interrogated by the police.

Fenech's arrest, and suspicion that people in government circles were involved in the crime, sparked protests all across the country. Joseph Muscat, prime minister at the time, was accused of protecting political allies and stepped down in January 2020. Fenech spent more than five years in detention before being released on bail, under strict conditions, in early 2025.

His trial only began this summer , and the final verdict was decisive. Eight of the nine jurors rejected the prosecution's argument that it was Fenech who had ordered the journalist's murder.

The prosecution case relied above all on the testimony of Melvin Theuma, who confessed to being the middleman and testified that Fenech had contracted him to organize the murder. Theuma received a pardon in exchange for his cooperation.

But Fenech's defense called Theuma's credibility into question, highlighting contradictions in his testimony and false statements he had made previously.

Fenech's lawyers also sought to prove that evidence pointing to Keith Schembri, chief of staff to Muscat at the time, was not properly followed up. Schembri has denied any involvement in the murder, and the...
body.zh: 马耳他商人约根·费内奇 (Yorgen Fenech) 被判无罪谋杀记者达芙妮·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚 (Daphne Caruana Galizia)。袭击发生近九年后，谁下令杀害她的问题仍然没有答案。 周三晚上，当约根·费内奇 (Yorgen Fenech) 离开瓦莱塔法院时，他遇到了外面愤怒的人群。这位 44 岁的马耳他商人在保安的簇拥下推门而入。就在几分钟前，陪审团宣布他下令谋杀 53 岁调查记者达芙妮·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚 (Daphne Caruana Galizia) 无罪。 这一判决令她的家人感到震惊。她的儿子马修·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚 (Matthew Caruana Galizia) 表示，这是“陪审团做出的可怕决定，我们的国家可能永远无法从中恢复过来”。后来他加大了批评力度，在脸书上发帖称这一判决“淫秽”，并表示：“他们的决定违背了所有证据、所有逻辑和事实。” 卡鲁阿娜·加利齐亚 (Caruana Galizia) 被谋杀近九年后，马耳他再次面临关键问题：谁应对 2017 年 10 月 16 日她的死亡负责？购买炸弹、将其放置在驾驶员座椅下并远程引爆的人已被定罪。但与他们签约的人的身份仍未得到合法确认。 多年来，费内奇被认为是调查的核心人物。他于2019年11月20日上午被捕，就像电影里的情节一样。他的豪华游艇“Gio”刚刚离开港口，就被一艘马耳他军事巡逻艇拦住。费内奇在船上被捕，随后受到警方审问。 费内奇被捕，以及政府人士涉嫌参与犯罪的怀疑，引发了全国各地的抗议活动。时任总理约瑟夫·马斯喀特 (Joseph Muscat) 被指控保护政治盟友，并于 2020 年 1 月下台。费内奇 (Fenech) 被拘留了五年多，然后于 2025 年初在严格条件下获得保释。 他的审判今年夏天才开始，最终的判决是决定性的。九名陪审员中的八名驳回了检方关于是费内奇下令谋杀记者的论点。 检方的指控首先依赖于梅尔文·西玛 (Melvin Theuma) 的证词，他承认自己是中间人，并证明芬内奇与他签约组织了这起谋杀案。作为合作的交换，Theuma 获得了赦免。 但费内奇的辩护对西玛的可信度提出了质疑，强调了他的证词中的矛盾以及他之前所做的虚假陈述。 费内奇的律师还试图证明指向当时马斯喀特参谋长基思·谢姆布里的证据没有得到适当的跟进。申布里否认与这起谋杀案有任何牵连，而且……

reflection.en: The acquittal of Yorgen Fenech in the murder of Daphne Caruana Galizia leaves a deep wound of injustice. The family's anguish and the public's fury underscore the cry for accountability when the legal system fails to deliver justice. This echoes Habakkuk's lament over a broken justice system, where the law is paralyzed and the wicked go unpunished.
reflection.zh: 尤尔根·费内赫在达芙妮·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚谋杀案中的无罪判决留下了深深的不公创伤。家属的痛苦和公众的愤怒，凸显了当法律体系未能伸张正义时，对问责制的呼喊。这呼应了哈巴谷对破碎司法体系的哀叹，即法律瘫痪而恶人逍遥法外。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: Yemen: Fighting intensifies amid Houthi push in the west
title.zh: 也门：胡塞武装在西部加剧战斗

summary.en: Houthi forces are intensifying their efforts to seize high ground and secure control of the Red Sea's southwestern entry points. This escalation follows their abandonment of a fragile truce in July with the Saudi-backed government-in-exile, leading to renewed ground offensives and significant losses on both sides.
summary.zh: 胡塞武装正加紧努力，试图夺取高地并巩固其对红海西南部入口的控制权。此次升级是在其于7月放弃与沙特支持的流亡政府之间脆弱的休战之后发生的，导致双方地面攻势重燃并遭受重大损失。

body.zh: 胡塞武装正试图夺取制高点，巩固对西南部红海入口的控制。伊朗支持的民兵组织于七月放弃了与沙特支持的流亡政府之间不稳定的休战协议。 也门长期内战双方都因胡塞民兵试图夺取西部红海门户的控制权而遭受损失。 伊朗支持的胡塞武装控制着首都萨那和该国大部分地区，周四对沙特阿拉伯领导的支持也门流亡政府的联盟发动地面攻势。 目前尚未正式公布伤亡数字，但新闻机构援引非公开消息人士的话说，双方均造成数十人伤亡，还有平民在战斗中丧生。截至周五，法新社统计有 129 人死亡。 官员们还报告说，炮击和炮火迫使数百个家庭逃离荷台达和莫卡这两个沿海城市，冲突双方都控制着这两个城市。 也门已经处于内战状态近12年了，今年7月在海湾地区与伊朗的战争中，一段相对平静的时期被打破。 胡塞武装的目标是沙特领导的部队控制的港口和高地，这将加强他们对曼德海峡的控制，该海峡是红海与亚丁湾的交汇处，通向阿拉伯海和公海。 它始终是一条重要的水道，在霍尔木兹海峡的交通受到限制的情况下，它的重要性日益增加。 胡塞武装宣布封锁接近沙特阿拉伯西海岸的船只，通过霍尔木兹进入沙特阿拉伯东部港口的通道已经受阻。但他们并没有处于理想的位置或能力来实现他们所表达的愿望。 然而，尽管他们对相关海岸线的控制并不完善，但他们已经向几艘商船开火，造成了一些严重损害和死亡。 军方消息人士私下告诉德新社和法新社，双方均造成多人伤亡。 DPA 统计的双方人数均为数十人，法新社则更准确地估计双方人数约为 60 人。 据报道，西南两个省份塔伊兹和荷台达发生了陆地交火以及火箭和无人机的交火。 胡塞武装控制着荷台达北部的主要西部港口，但也门西南端塔伊兹的大部分地区，包括海峡附近的莫卡港，都由沙特领导的部队控制。 美国风险咨询公司 Basha Report 的穆罕默德·巴沙 (Mohammed al-Basha) 告诉法新社，“他们的目标是巴布·曼德布 (Bab al-Mandeb)”。 争夺制高点，例如在努曼山上俯瞰......

reflection.en: The conflict in Yemen, marked by the Houthi push for control of the Red Sea entry, illustrates the devastating human cost of prolonged warfare. In the midst of such global strife, the ancient promise that God will 'make wars cease' offers a profound hope for peace and an end to suffering.
reflection.zh: 也门冲突中，胡塞武装为争夺红海入口控制权而加剧战斗，这凸显了长期战争对人类造成的毁灭性代价。在这场全球性的冲突中，“雅伟必使刀枪作盐”的古老应许，为和平与结束苦难带来了深切的希望。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: Nigeria: Suspected oil thieves dead after inhaling fumes
title.zh: 尼日利亚：涉嫌盗油者吸入烟雾死亡

summary.en: At least 37 people died while attempting to illegally siphon crude oil from a ship in Nigeria, according to a local environmental group. Police confirmed a fatal incident but provided fewer details as investigations are ongoing.
summary.zh: 据尼日利亚一个环保组织称，至少有37人在试图非法从一艘船上盗取原油时死亡。警方证实发生了致命事件，但因调查仍在进行，提供的细节较少。

body.zh: 尼日利亚环保组织表示，至少有 37 人在试图从船上非法抽取原油时死亡。警方承认发生了一起致命事件，但透露的细节较少，称调查仍在继续。 尼日利亚一个环保非政府组织表示，在该国南部试图从一艘装货船上非法开采石油的过程中，至少有 37 人死亡。 青年与宣传中心表示，他们中的大多数人因吸入有害烟雾而死亡。 尼日利亚当局尚未公布死亡人数，但承认发生了一起致命事件，其中有人被杀，显然是在试图窃取原油时。 这起事件于周四夜间发生在该国南部石油资源丰富的尼日尔三角洲河流州的奥克里卡。 该环保组织表示，这起事件发生在码头，当时一艘船只正在通过哈科特港炼油厂从 Indorama Eleme 石化厂装载石油。死者是“疑似石油窃贼”，他们试图在“非法采油点”将石油转移到船上。 非政府组织青年与倡导中心援引志愿者网络的话说，其他人仍然失踪，可能是在水中迷失的。 警方承认发生了一起事件，但表示他们将继续调查细节。 发言人布莱辛·阿格巴贝 (Blessing Agbabe) 表示：“河流州警察指挥部可以确认死亡事件。据称，受害者试图窃取原油。” 在非洲最大的石油生产国尼日利亚的尼日尔三角洲地区，石油盗窃相当普遍，该地区的石油矿区是贫困和环境退化的热点地区。 尼日利亚政府估计，石油盗窃行为每年造成数十亿美元的损失，并一直在努力打击这种行为。 如果得到证实，这将是至少自 2023 年 10 月以来有记录以来与企图盗窃石油有关的最严重的致命事故。 不过，尼日利亚安全和民防部队表示，流传的伤亡数字尚未得到证实，并表示正在与其他安全机构合作澄清细节。 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: The pursuit of illicit wealth can lead to devastating consequences, as seen in this tragic incident where 37 lives were lost. The allure of quick riches often blinds individuals to the inherent dangers and moral failings, leading to destruction rather than prosperity. This serves as a somber reminder of the destructive power of greed.
reflection.zh: 非法致富的追求可能导致毁灭性的后果，正如这起悲惨事件中37人丧生所显示的。快速致富的诱惑常常使人们对固有的危险和道德上的失败视而不见，最终导致毁灭而非繁荣。这警示我们贪婪的破坏力。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: The unexpected way China is accused of exerting influence in the Pacific
title.zh: 中国被指控影响太平洋的方式出人意料

summary.en: As Palau faces renewed criticism from China, its president is seeking Australian assistance to diversify its primary economic source, tourism.
summary.zh: 在帕劳再次面临中国的批评之际，其总统正寻求澳大利亚的援助，以实现其主要经济来源——旅游业的多元化。

body.en:
As our boat bobs along clear turquoise waters, the local operator hands us snorkelling masks. You don’t need them, though, to see a stunning coral reef and schools of vibrant fish surrounded by historic limestone islands.

In a nearby lake, we swim under the hot sun and among hundreds of jellyfish, some tickling our legs and arms. They’re harmless, Palau’s president Surangel Whipps Jr, had earlier assured us.

Whipps, fresh from hosting a highly charged Pacific Islands Forum, proudly points to the postcard landscape behind him: “This is my office”, he declares.

It’s in Palau, a Micronesian nation dotting the western Pacific, with a population of just 18,000, that China has triggered its sting. The reason: Palau is one of just 12 countries in the world to formally recognise Taiwan, a decision that has long angered Beijing, but its wrath was felt on the global stage this week.

Just days before 2,000 people were expected to converge on the island for the 55th Pacific Islands Forum leaders’ meeting, China issued a travel advisory to its residents, warning them of “theft” and “a dangerous local marine environment”.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Whipps said it was “unfortunate” that Beijing was “weaponising tourism”, an industry Palau is heavily reliant on. More than 40 per cent of its GDP comes from the tourism industry.

“We live in a free world. We should enjoy each other’s treasures and treat each other with respect, and I hope that the people in China see that,” Whipps said.

“Maybe [Chinese] leadership has a different opinion, but at the end of the day, we're all people of this one planet, and we care about each other.”

Palau’s ambassador to Taiwan Gaafar Uherbelau says this isn’t the first time China has used tourism to respond to diplomatic spats.

“We saw a peak in Chinese tourists that came in, and then all of a sudden we saw a plunge due to this ongoing tension that we got caught in between,” Uherbelau says.

In 2015, Palau boasted more than 165,000 visitors from around the world, and more than 91,000 of them came from China alone. Last year, total visitors were just two-thirds of that number, recording just 65,558 people.

But in November 2017, the Chinese government ended chartered flights to the island and ordered tour operators to stop selling package tours to Palau, in what was unofficially known as a “tourism ban”. By 2019, Palau’s total visitor numbers had halved to just 85,000 and tourism from China plummeted by 63 per cent.

Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk...
reflection.zh: 帕劳总统正驾驭复杂的地缘政治水域，寻求实现其国家经济的多元化，摆脱对单一伙伴的过度依赖。这种情况要求在国际交往中运用智慧和正直，确保关系建立在相互尊重和公平的基础上，而非胁迫。 弥迦书6:8呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与我们的神同行。愿各国领导人和国家在交往中都寻求这些原则，营造使小国能够蓬勃发展而不受不当压力的环境。

title.en: Rescuers in Nepal find two more people alive after flash flood disaster
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水灾难：救援人员在洪灾后找到另外两人活口

summary.en: Rescuers in Nepal have found two more survivors, a Chinese man at the Trishuli hydropower project and a Nepali woman in Nuwakot, ten days after massive floods hit the country. The Chinese man was rescued from a 225-meter tunnel and is undergoing a health assessment, while the search continues for thousands still...
summary.zh: 尼泊尔洪水灾难发生十天后，救援人员找到了另外两名幸存者：一名在中国水电项目中被困的中国男子和一名在努瓦科特的尼泊尔妇女。这名中国男子从225米深的隧道中被救出，目前正在接受健康评估，搜救行动仍在继续，仍有数千人失踪。

body.en: Chinese man at Trishuli hydropower project and Nepali woman in Nuwakot found 10 days into rescue operation Emergency responders have rescued a Chinese man and a Nepali woman in two separate operations as authorities continued to search for thousands of people missing 10 days after massive floods hit Nepal. The Nepali military said on Saturday a joint team comprising personnel from its army and South Korean disaster experts rescued the man from a 225-metre (740ft) tunnel in the Upper Trishuli-1 hydropower project, and that he was undergoing a health assessment. Pictures showed him being evacuated by helicopter after being carried out of the tunnel. Continue reading...
body.zh: 特里苏里水电项目的中国男子和努瓦科特的尼泊尔妇女在救援行动进行10天后被发现 周六，紧急救援人员在两次单独的行动中救出了一名中国男子和一名尼泊尔妇女，尼泊尔大洪水袭击10天后，当局仍在继续搜寻数千名失踪人员。尼泊尔军方表示，一支由军队人员和韩国灾难专家组成的联合小组从上特里苏里一号水电项目的一条 225 米（740 英尺）长的隧道中救出了这名男子，目前他正在接受健康评估。照片显示，他被带出隧道后被直升机疏散。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the midst of devastating floods in Nepal, the discovery of survivors ten days later offers a profound glimmer of hope. These rescues, like finding a stranger in distress, echo the words of Jesus: "Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me." It reminds us that every life is precious and...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔毁灭性的洪水灾难中，十天后发现幸存者带来了深刻的希望之光。这些救援行动，如同在困境中找到陌生人一样，呼应了耶稣的话：“我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。”这提醒我们，每一个生命都无比珍贵，每一次救援行动都是神圣的职责。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: India news: 275 Indians still missing in Nepal floods
title.zh: 印度新闻：尼泊尔洪水仍有275名印度人失踪

summary.en: Official estimates indicate that 275 Indians remain unaccounted for following the catastrophic floods in Nepal. Concurrently, reports suggest no Indian travelers are stranded in flood-affected Tibet.
summary.zh: 官方估计显示，在尼泊尔灾难性的洪水之后，仍有275名印度人下落不明。与此同时，有报道称没有印度旅客滞留在受洪水影响的西藏地区。

body.zh: 官方估计，尼泊尔洪水灾难中仍有 275 名印度人下落不明。与此同时，据说没有印度游客滞留在受洪水影响的西藏。 DW还有更多。 厌倦了错过我们的实时更新？单击此处将我们添加为 Google 上的首选来源。然后点击“星标”或“首选”，将 DW News 保留在您的 Feed 顶部。 印度表示，在山洪袭击尼泊尔和西藏边境地区十天后，仍有 275 名印度国民失踪。 印度外交部发言人兰迪尔·贾伊斯瓦尔(Randhir Jaiswal)周五晚间表示，迄今为止，尼泊尔洪灾地区共有169名印度人获救。 杰斯瓦尔表示，在最新的救援行动中，三名印度人，包括一名五岁儿童，被从尼泊尔特里苏利集市救至安全地带。 “我们驻尼泊尔大使馆正在协助他们乘飞机返回印度，”他在 X 日表示。 该发言人在新德里举行的新闻发布会上表示，1,907 名印度国民已从中国安全越境前往尼泊尔。 杰斯瓦尔援引中国官方消息来源宣布，目前没有印度旅客滞留在西藏自治区。 尼泊尔官方公布的洪水死亡人数目前为 1,294 人，仍有 5,053 人失踪。 为了寻找幸存者，疯狂的救援工作已经持续了数天，特别是在充满泥浆的水电隧道中，据信有数百名工人被困。 周六，新德里驻加德满都特使表示，印度隧道救援队与尼泊尔国防军在拉苏瓦奇莱姆水电站合作，已加强行动。 印度大使纳文·斯里瓦斯塔瓦（Naveen Srivastava）表示：“昨天，印度隧道救援队与尼泊尔军队合作，在奇莱姆隧道中挖得更深，排水。还修建了一条临时轨道，以便更多重型设备进入隧道。” 他补充说，陪同印度救援人员的医生还为当地社区举办了一个健康营。 杰斯瓦尔周五表示，自 8 月 26 日洪水袭击尼泊尔以来，印度还向尼泊尔提供了近 95 吨救灾物资。 我是来自德国之声德里工作室的 Dharvi，为您带来我们印度博客的周末版，我们将详细分析在这个世界上人口最多的国家引起轰动的所有头条新闻。 尼泊尔-西藏灾难性洪灾中仍有 275 名印度人失踪，死亡人数已突破 1,200 人。 外交消息方面，下周金砖国家峰会在新德里已经开始倒计时。印度将作为经济集团主席国接待成员国领导人。 与此同时，在体育界，印度运动员正在以一种相当非传统的方式为亚运会做准备——睡在集装箱式的单位里。

reflection.en: Amidst the devastation of the Nepal floods, 275 Indian nationals are still missing. This crisis underscores the vulnerability of travelers and the profound human need for safety and connection. In these moments of uncertainty and loss, we are called to remember that compassion extended to those in distress, even strangers, is an act of service to the divine.
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔洪水灾难的背景下，仍有275名印度国民失踪。这场危机凸显了旅客的脆弱性以及人类对安全和联系的深切需求。在这些充满不确定和失落的时刻，我们被呼召要铭记，向处于困境中的人，即使是陌生人，伸出援手，也是一种对神圣的服侍。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: Watch: Moment workers are rescued from Nepal tunnel
title.zh: 视频：尼泊尔隧道工人获救瞬间

summary.en: Rescuers pull two people from a hydropower tunnel more than a week after a massive flash flood devastated the Nepal-China border.
summary.zh: 在导致尼泊尔-中国边境地区遭受毁灭性洪灾一周多后，救援人员从一座水电站隧道中救出了两人。

reflection.en: In the aftermath of disaster, the focus often shifts to the immense scale of destruction. Yet, amidst the rubble and the waiting, the rescue of two individuals from the Nepal tunnel shines a light on the preciousness of each human life. Jesus taught that whatever we do for the least of these, we do for Him.
reflection.zh: 在灾难的余波中，人们的注意力常常转向巨大的破坏规模。然而，在瓦砾和等待之中，从尼泊尔隧道中救出两名个人的事件，彰显了每个人的生命都何等宝贵。耶稣教导说，凡你们为我这些最小的弟兄做的，就是为我做的。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: ‘Everyone seems to have forgotten’: In Tibet, flood-hit families search for the missing and grapple with China’s silence
title.zh: 在西藏，“每个人似乎都已忘记”：洪水肆虐家庭寻找失踪者，并与中国的沉默作斗争

summary.en: Relatives are trying to gather information online and from Nepal, while Tibet advocacy groups report that information is being suppressed in China. Fan Hong last heard from her husband, Lin Bo, who was working on a Chinese highway project in Nepal, on the morning of the disaster. Over a week later, she is desperately...
summary.zh: 亲属们正试图从网上和尼泊尔收集信息，而西藏倡导团体则报告信息在中国受到压制。范红在尼泊尔-西藏灾难发生当晚听到了她丈夫林波的消息，林波当时正在尼泊尔的一个中国公路项目上工作。一周多过去了，她仍在绝望地寻找他，难以从当局那里获得信息，并转向了社交媒体。

More than a week later, the 31-year-old is desperately searching for information about Lin Bo, who was working on a Chinese highway project in Nepal. Struggling to get information from authorities, Fan turned to social media for help. “My husband works on a project in Nepal, about 5 kilometres from the Gyirong border crossing. I want to know what the situation is, but I haven’t been able to reach him,” the 31-year-old from China’s Sichuan province wrote on Rednote. Continue reading...

reflection.en: In the aftermath of the Nepal-Tibet disaster, families like Fan Hong's are left in agonizing uncertainty, struggling to find information about their missing loved ones. The silence from authorities and the difficulty in accessing news echo the plight of those who are often voiceless. This situation calls us to remember and advocate for those whose suffering...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔-西藏灾难发生后，像范红这样的家庭陷入了痛苦的不确定之中，努力寻找失踪亲人的信息。当局的沉默和获取新闻的困难，呼应了那些常常无声者的困境。这种情况提醒我们要铭记并为那些可能被遗忘的受苦者发声，这体现了圣经中为不能为自己发声者说话的呼召。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Pacific leaders voice concern over Chinese missile test but stop short of condemnation
title.zh: 太平洋领导人对中国导弹试验表示担忧，但未予谴责

summary.en: The Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) concluded with most member nations agreeing to "register concern" over China's recent intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) test, which overflew several members without adequate notice. Leaders urged transparency and advance notification for such tests, with Nauru being the sole...
summary.zh: 太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）闭幕，多数成员国同意就中国近期洲际弹道导弹（ICBM）试验“表示关切”，该试验在未获充分通知的情况下飞越了部分成员国领土。领导人敦促所有进行ICBM试验的国家确保透明度和保障，包括按照国际惯例至少提前24小时发出通知。18个成员国中，瑙鲁是唯一一个对此条款持异议的国家。

body.en:
The Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) has wrapped up with most nations agreeing to "register concern" on China's recent intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) test, "which overflew a number of members without adequate notice".

"Leaders call on all states undertaking ICBM testing to ensure transparency and reassurance, including through the provision of advance notification of a test at least 24 hours in accordance with international practice," the communique says, as read out by Palau's President and PIF chair Surangel Whipps Junior, after the closing ceremony.

In a rare move for the usually consensus-based forum, Nauru was the only one of 18 PIF members to dissent from the clause.

Kiribati and Nauru were the only two Pacific nations that had previously blocked a draft PIF statement in the immediate aftermath of Beijing's test, a move that Prime Minister Anthony Albanese had been advocating for.

However the statement went further than analysts and government sources had expected; the PIF foreign ministers' meeting statement in August was broader, discussing ballistic missile testing in the region, but had stopped short of singling out a particular ICBM or referencing a notice period for nations to undergo any testing.

Whipps also hit back against China's comments that Palau sensationalised its ballistic missile test, saying: "There's no sensationalism, it's just stating the facts."

"The Pacific Islands weren't informed [of the test]. The ones that were informed were informed late, and so I think the message from the forum is clear: that transparency needs to happen."

Intelligence shows the nuclear-capable intercontinental ballistic missile test in July flew over the Philippines, Palau and Micronesia's airspace before landing in the Pacific Ocean.

The response has become something of a litmus test for PIF and its members for their strategic positioning.

The communique's relevant clause includes a reference to the Fiji-led Ocean of Peace declaration made last year, which states the region should be free from coercion and militarisation.

However, it doesn't name China, nor does it use heftier diplomatic language than "concern".

While Australian officials were happy with the agreed statement, it fell short of some pre-retreat expectations, including those of the host, Palau.

"They sent a missile next to French Polynesia, another one next to Tuvalu, crossing over our airspace. They never bothered to tell us that's what's happening," he said.

"I said 'there's a lot of space between Japan and Guam, why don't you send it there? Why does it have to come to the middle of the Pacific when last year we just signed a...
body.zh: 太平洋岛屿论坛（PIF）结束时，大多数国家同意对中国最近的洲际弹道导弹（ICBM）试验“表达关切”，“该试验在没有充分通知的情况下飞越了一些成员国”。 帕劳总统兼太平洋岛国论坛主席苏兰吉尔·惠普斯·儒尼奥尔在闭幕式后宣读的公报称，“领导人呼吁所有进行洲际弹道导弹测试的国家确保透明度和保证，包括根据国际惯例至少提前 24 小时提前通知测试情况”。 对于这个通常以共识为基础的论坛来说，这是一个罕见的举动，瑙鲁是 18 个 PIF 成员中唯一不同意该条款的国家。 基里巴斯和瑙鲁是此前在北京试验后立即阻止PIF声明草案的仅有的两个太平洋国家，此举是总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯一直倡导的。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 然而，该声明超出了分析师和政府消息人士的预期；太平洋岛国论坛外交部长八月份的会议声明范围更广，讨论了该地区的弹道导弹试验，但没有单独指出特定的洲际弹道导弹或提及各国进行任何试验的通知期。 惠普斯还反驳了中国关于帕劳炒作其弹道导弹试验的言论，他说：“没有煽情，只是陈述事实。” “太平洋岛屿没有被告知（这次测试）。那些被告知的人却很晚才被告知，所以我认为论坛传达的信息很明确：需要实现透明度。” 情报显示，7月份进行的具有核能力的洲际弹道导弹试验飞越了菲律宾、帕劳和密克罗尼西亚的领空，然后降落在太平洋上。 这一回应已成为 PIF 及其成员战略定位的试金石。 公报的相关条款包括提及斐济去年发表的《和平海洋宣言》，该宣言指出该地区不应受到胁迫和军事化。 然而，它没有点名中国，也没有使用比“关切”更重的外交语言。 虽然澳大利亚官员对商定的声明感到满意，但它没有达到一些退会前的预期，包括东道主帕劳的预期。 “他们向法属波利尼西亚发射了一枚导弹，又向图瓦卢发射了一枚导弹，飞越了我们的领空。他们从来没有费心告诉我们发生了什么，”他说。 “我说‘日本和关岛之间有很大的空间，你为什么不把它送到那里？为什么它必须来到太平洋中部，去年我们刚刚签署了一份……

reflection.en: The leaders of the Pacific Islands Forum have expressed concern over a recent ICBM test that flew over their territories without sufficient warning. Their call for transparency and advance notification echoes the ancient prophetic vision of a world where such instruments of potential conflict are managed with greater care and consideration for all nations....
reflection.zh: 太平洋岛国论坛的领导人对近期一次未获充分预警便飞越其领土的洲际弹道导弹试验表示关切。他们呼吁提高透明度和提前通知，这呼应了古代先知的异象——一个世界，在那里，潜在冲突的工具能够得到更谨慎的处理，并顾及所有国家。 这一时刻凸显了国家安全利益与地区稳定之间的微妙平衡，敦促在国际事务中走上更加开放和相互保证的道路。

title.en: Reform’s media presenter worked for Chinese state propaganda channel
title.zh: 改革派媒体主持人曾在中国国家宣传频道工作

summary.en: Reform UK's top media presenter, Ray Addison, who hosts the party's podcast and social media campaigns, has worked for a Chinese state propaganda channel within the past year. Addison presented films about Xinjiang province, where China faces accusations of genocide, for state media in September 2025.
summary.zh: 据《卫报》报道，英国改革党（Reform UK）的首席媒体主持人雷·阿迪森（Ray Addison）在过去一年中曾为中国国家宣传频道工作。阿迪森曾于2025年9月为中国官媒制作了关于新疆省的影片，而中国在该地区面临种族灭绝的指控。

body.en: Party podcast and social media host Ray Addison fronted films about province where China is accused of genocide Reform UK’s top media presenter has worked for a Chinese state propaganda channel within the past year, the Guardian can reveal. Ray Addison, who presents the political party’s in-house podcast and social media campaigns, fronted films about Xinjiang province – where the Chinese government is accused of committing genocide – for state media in September 2025. reflection.en: The news that a political party's media presenter has worked for a state propaganda channel raises questions about truthfulness and integrity in public communication. Ephesians 4:25 calls believers to "put off falsehood and speak truthfully to one another," a principle vital for maintaining trust in political discourse and media.
reflection.zh: 一名政党媒体主持人曾为国家宣传频道工作的消息，引发了关于公共传播中真实性和诚信的疑问。以弗所书4章25节呼吁信徒“各人与邻舍说实话”，这一原则对于在政治言论和媒体中维持信任至关重要。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Malaysia's middle path between China and US faces new tests
title.zh: 马来西亚在中国和美国之间走中间道路面临新考验

summary.en: Malaysia's Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim's recent comments on Taiwan and US-backed military facilities have raised questions about the sustainability of the nation's non-aligned foreign policy as US-China rivalry intensifies in Southeast Asia.
summary.zh: 马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣最近就台湾和美国支持的军事设施发表的言论，在美中竞争日益加剧的东南亚地区，引发了对该国不结盟外交政策可持续性的质疑。

body.en:
The prime minister's comments on Taiwan and US-backed military facilities near Sabah have revived questions over Malaysia's non-aligned foreign policy.

Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim has spent much of his time in office insisting that Kuala Lumpur will not be forced to choose between the United States and China .

But two sets of comments last month have raised questions about how sustainable that position is as rivalry between the two superpowers increasingly spills into Southeast Asia.

"I see Taiwan as part of China, period," he said in an interview with news outlet Al Jazeera that aired on August 16.

Beijing considers democratically governed  Taiwan part of its territory. While Chinese leaders say they favor "peaceful reunification," they have never ruled out using force to bring the island under Beijing's control.

More controversially, Anwar appeared to accept Beijing's argument that force could be necessary.

"If one province decides to break away. Do we use force? I think I will, [to] protect the sanctity and unity of the nation," he said.

The comments drew an enthusiastic response from Beijing, while Taiwan's Foreign Ministry accused Anwar of effectively legitimizing the use of force against the island and warned that his "one-sided support for China could negatively impact Taiwanese businesses' confidence in investing in Malaysia," including in the country's strategically important semiconductor sector.

Two days after his comments on Taiwan aired, Anwar argued that Malaysia  should strengthen its defenses in Sabah, citing the expansion of US-backed military facilities on the nearby Philippine island of Balabac.

The Philippines is upgrading facilities on Balabac, roughly 50 kilometers (31 miles) from the Malaysian islands of Banggi and Balambangan.

Balabac was one of four additional locations added in 2023 to the Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement, which allows US forces to access designated Philippine military facilities, construct infrastructure and pre-position equipment.

Taken together, Anwar's comments raised concerns that Malaysia is growing warmer toward Beijing while becoming more suspicious of Washington's military footprint in the region.

Kuala Lumpur has also been one of the region's strongest critics of Israel's actions in Gaza . Anwar has repeatedly accused the United States and European governments of hypocrisy and double standards for championing democracy and international law while failing, in his view, to hold Israel sufficiently accountable.

But Malaysia experts warn against interpreting Anwar's rhetoric as evidence of a fundamental strategic realignment.

"Malaysia still maintains very good relations with the US and other Western countries," Ngeow Chow Bing, director of the Institute...
body.zh: 总理对台湾和沙巴附近美国支持的军事设施的评论再次引发了对马来西亚不结盟外交政策的质疑。 马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣(Anwar Ibrahim)在任期间大部分时间都坚称，吉隆坡不会被迫在美国和中国之间做出选择。 但上个月的两套评论引发了人们的疑问，随着两个超级大国之间的竞争日益蔓延到东南亚，这一立场的可持续性如何。 “我认为台湾是中国的一部分，就这样，”他在接受半岛电视台 8 月 16 日播出的采访时说道。 北京认为台湾是其领土的一部分，实行民主治理。尽管中国领导人表示支持“和平统一”，但他们从未排除使用武力将该岛置于北京的控制之下。 更具争议性的是，安瓦尔似乎接受了北京关于可能需要使用武力的论点。 “如果一个省决定脱离。我们会使用武力吗？我想我会，[以]保护国家的神圣和统一，”他说。 这些言论引起了北京的热烈回应，而台湾外交部则指责安瓦尔实际上使对台湾使用武力合法化，并警告说，他“对中国的片面支持可能会对台湾企业投资马来西亚的信心产生负面影响”，包括对该国具有重要战略意义的半导体行业的投资。 在发表有关台湾的言论两天后，安瓦尔认为马来西亚应该加强在沙巴的防御，并列举了美国支持的在附近的菲律宾巴拉巴克岛扩建军事设施的情况。 菲律宾正在升级巴拉巴克岛的设施，该岛距离马来西亚班吉岛和巴兰班安岛约 50 公里（31 英里）。 巴拉巴克是 2023 年《增强防务合作协议》新增的四个地点之一，该协议允许美军进入菲律宾指定军事设施、建设基础设施和预置设备。 总而言之，安瓦尔的言论引发了人们的担忧，即马来西亚对北京的态度越来越好，同时对华盛顿在该地区的军事足迹越来越怀疑。 吉隆坡也是该地区对以色列在加沙行动最强烈的批评者之一。安瓦尔一再指责美国和欧洲政府在倡导民主和国际法方面虚伪和双重标准，同时他认为，未能让以色列承担足够的责任。 但马来西亚专家警告不要将安瓦尔的言论解读为根本战略调整的证据。 “马来西亚仍然与美国和其他西方国家保持着非常良好的关系，”该中心主任Ngeow Chow Bing...

reflection.en: Malaysia's Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim seeks to navigate a delicate path between global powers, aiming to avoid choosing sides. This pursuit of balance reflects a desire for peace and stability in a complex geopolitical landscape. The challenge lies in upholding this 'middle path' when external pressures mount, testing the nation's resolve to foster good...
reflection.zh: 马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣试图在两大全球势力之间走一条微妙的道路，力求不选边站队。这种寻求平衡的努力，反映了在复杂的地缘政治格局中对和平与稳定的渴望。当外部压力增大时，如何坚持这条“中间道路”并促进与各方的良好关系，是对国家决心的考验。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Dozens of trapped hydropower tunnel workers in Nepal could still be alive, official says
title.zh: 尼泊尔水电隧道数十名被困工人仍有可能活着，官员称
