title.en: Why the 'great Aussie summer' may become a thing of the past
title.zh: 为什么“伟大的澳大利亚夏天”可能成为过去

summary.en: Should we schedule our 'peak' summer — holidays, school breaks and sporting events — according to safety rather than tradition? Last summer, Paris Brooke watched in horror as a bushfire blazed through the national park across the lake from her township of Mallacoota in north-east Victoria. The exodus was reminiscent...
summary.zh: 我们是否应该根据安全而不是传统来安排我们的“高峰”夏季——假期、学校休息和体育赛事？去年夏天，巴黎·布鲁克惊恐地看着一场丛林大火在她家乡维多利亚州东北部马拉库塔镇对面的湖泊上燃烧。这次撤离让人想起 2019-20 年夏天，澳大利亚的“黑色夏天”丛林大火席卷并摧毁了这个海滨小镇。马拉库塔是受灾最严重的地区之一。

body.en:
Last summer, Paris Brooke watched in horror as a bushfire blazed through the national park across the lake from her township of Mallacoota in north-east Victoria.

"The camp park emptied out overnight, leaving businesses that depend on summer tourism stuck with unused supplies and staff, but no more tourists," Brooke tells SBS News.

The exodus was reminiscent of the summer of 2019-20, when Australia's Black Summer bushfires swept through and devastated the beachside town.

Mallacoota was among the hardest-hit areas . Apocalyptic-looking scenes of residents and holidaymakers sheltering in boats off the coast, under a red sky thick with smoke, were broadcast around the world.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

While Brooke hasn't necessarily seen a slowdown in holidaymakers to the town since, she believes stays are shortening and worries the increased likelihood of extreme weather will hit summer trade long-term.

It's why she set up the Wilderness Collective, a community not-for-profit aimed at helping locals build new skills and businesses to reduce reliance on summer tourism.

"People are much more aware of natural disasters such as bushfires or droughts," she says.

On the same day last summer, climate scientist Linden Ashcroft was on the beach in Mallacoota. She recalls her kids playing in the water as embers and burnt leaves fell around them.

"It was pretty heartbreaking and terrifying. Everyone was really creeped out, and the town was covered in smoke," she says.

It left her with a lasting sense of cognitive dissonance — this is not how summer is supposed to feel.

That feeling is now rippling around the country, reaching far beyond places like Mallacoota that are historically prone to bushfires.

"Black Summer 2019–2020 was a real step change; it made people face the reality that summer can't just be carefree anymore," Ashcroft says.

Climate Council director and academic Lesley Hughes says the changing climate is reshaping Australians' notion of summer: instead of looking forward to it, people increasingly feel apprehensive.

"They dread the heatwaves, the bushfires, not being able to do the things they used to. Climate change is stealing the part of the year Australians looked forward to most."

With higher temperatures and more extreme weather events becoming a fixture of the holiday season in parts of the country, could this signal the end of 'great Aussie summer'?

Australia is now 1.5C warmer on average than it was a century ago, according to the National Climate Risk Assessment. It's driving more extreme heatwaves and dangerous fire weather.

Monash climate scientist Andrew Watkins, former head of the Bureau of...
body.zh: 去年夏天，帕丽斯·布鲁克惊恐地看到一场丛林大火席卷了维多利亚州东北部马拉库塔镇与湖对岸的国家公园。 布鲁克告诉 SBS 新闻：“营地公园一夜之间就空了，依赖夏季旅游业的企业陷入了闲置的物资和员工困境，但没有更多的游客。” 这种逃亡让人想起2019-20年夏天，当时澳大利亚的黑夏丛林大火席卷并摧毁了这座海滨小镇。 马拉库塔是受灾最严重的地区之一。世界各地都在播放着世界末日般的场景，居民和度假者在浓烟滚滚的红色天空下，在海岸附近的船上避难。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 虽然布鲁克此后并没有看到到该镇度假的人数有所减少，但她认为停留时间正在缩短，并担心极端天气可能性的增加将长期影响夏季贸易。 这就是为什么她成立了 Wilderness Collective，这是一个非营利性社区，旨在帮助当地人培养新技能和开展业务，以减少对夏季旅游的依赖。 “人们对森林大火或干旱等自然灾害有了更多的认识，”她说。 去年夏天的同一天，气候科学家林登·阿什克罗夫特在马拉库塔的海滩上。她回忆起孩子们在水里玩耍时，余烬和烧焦的树叶落在他们周围。 “这真是令人心碎和可怕。每个人都吓坏了，整个城镇都笼罩在烟雾中，”她说。 这给她留下了一种持久的认知失调感——这不是夏天应该有的感觉。 这种感觉现在正在全国蔓延，远远超出了像马拉库塔这样历史上容易发生丛林大火的地方。 阿什克罗夫特说：“2019-2020 年的黑色夏天是一个真正的转变；它让人们面对现实，夏天不能再无忧无虑了。” 气候委员会主任兼学者莱斯利·休斯表示，气候变化正在重塑澳大利亚人对夏季的看法：人们不再期待夏季，而是越来越感到担忧。 “他们害怕热浪、丛林大火，无法做以前做的事情。气候变化正在抢走澳大利亚人一年中最期待的部分。” 随着更高的气温和更多的极端天气事件成为该国部分地区假期的固定内容，这是否标志着“伟大的澳大利亚夏季”的结束？ 根据国家气候风险评估，澳大利亚现在的平均气温比一个世纪前高 1.5 摄氏度。它正在引发更加极端的热浪和危险的火灾天气。 莫纳什气候科学家安德鲁·沃特金斯 (Andrew Watkins)，前气象局局长...

reflection.en: The Australian summer, a time of tradition and celebration, is increasingly threatened by the harsh realities of climate change. The fires described in Mallacoota are not just isolated incidents but symptoms of a larger distress, a 'groaning' of creation as described in Romans 8:22. As we face these disruptions, may we seek wisdom to adapt our traditions...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚的夏天，一个充满传统和庆祝的季节，正日益受到气候变化严峻现实的威胁。马拉库塔所描述的火灾不仅仅是孤立的事件，更是更大痛苦的征兆，正如罗马书 8:22 所述，是受造之物的“叹息”。当我们面对这些干扰时，愿我们寻求智慧来调整我们的传统，并照管托付给我们的土地。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Hong Kong Desk
title.zh: 香港快讯

strap.en: News, policy, and public life in Hong Kong.
strap.zh: 聚焦香港时事、政策与社会动态。

title.en: Chinese guitar capital’s stairway to export heaven
title.zh: 中国吉他之都的出口天堂之路

summary.en: The town of Zheng'an in China's Guizhou province has become a global center for guitar manufacturing, producing one in seven of the world's guitars. A decade ago, the industry did not exist, but now giant guitar sculptures and murals signify its dominance in the local landscape.
summary.zh: 中国贵州省的郑安县已成为全球吉他制造中心，生产了全球七分之一的吉他。十年前，这里还没有这个产业，但如今巨大的吉他雕塑和壁画标志着它在当地景观中的主导地位。

body.en: It doesn’t take long to guess the main industry of the Chinese town of Zheng’an. A giant guitar sculpture dominates the central square, guitar murals adorn walls and pavements and even the rubbish bins are shaped like guitars. This photo taken on July 27, 2026 shows a worker making a guitar at a guitar workshop in Zheng’an, in southwestern China’s Guizhou Province. Photo: Jade Gao/AFP. This corner of the southwest province of Guizhou produces one in every seven of the instruments sold worldwide. A decade ago, it had no guitar-making industry to speak of at all. There are hundreds of specialised manufacturing towns in China, producing items ranging from bicycles to socks. But the speed and scale of Zheng’an’s rise make it an example of the impact of China’s industrial strategy when a combination of local and central government investment is deployed to maximise favourable local conditions. For years, the town’s working-age residents left to find employment in factories in Guangdong, southern China’s manufacturing hub. Among them was Zheng Chuanjiu, who eventually started his own guitar-making business in the provincial capital Guangzhou. “The company was doing pretty well at that time and most of our staff in Guangzhou were also our fellow villagers from Zheng’an,” the founder of Shenqu Guitar told AFP. Embed from Getty Images In 2012, Zheng’an local authorities rolled out an initiative called “return the phoenix to the nest”, to encourage skilled migrant workers to return home and start businesses. “The county officials reached out to us. They wanted us to come back and develop the industry,” Zheng said. Shenqu became the first guitar manufacturer to settle in Zheng’an’s new economic zone. “After I’d been working here for a few years, many friends saw how well I was doing and came here to join me to develop the industry,” he said. When AFP visited Shenqu in July, rows upon rows of finished guitars sat neatly on racks, awaiting final tuning checks before shipment. “Why go far away to work when home is the best place?” a banner in the factory read. Natural advantages Within around 10 years, 87 home‑grown brands had emerged from the industrial cluster. Embed from Getty Images Authorities enticed companies with comprehensive financial, tax and employment support packages — some were offered three‑year tax exemptions and 10 years of free rent. Importantly though, Zheng’an has natural advantages in its favour. The area’s climate is perfect for guitar-making, according to master luthier Zhang Weiyi, who relocated his business from Guangzhou in 2019. “Whether the industry is big or small,...
body.zh: 不用多久就可以猜出中国正安小镇的主要产业。中央广场上矗立着巨大的吉他雕塑，墙壁和人行道上装饰着吉他壁画，甚至垃圾桶的形状也像吉他。这张照片拍摄于 2026 年 7 月 27 日，中国西南部贵州省正安市的一个吉他作坊里，一名工人正在制作吉他。照片：Jade Gau/法新社。全球销售的乐器中，七分之一的乐器都产自贵州省西南部的这个角落。十年前，它根本没有吉他制造行业可言。中国有数百个专业制造城镇，生产从自行车到袜子等各种产品。但正安崛起的速度和规模使其成为中国产业战略影响的一个例子，该战略将地方和中央政府投资结合起来，最大限度地发挥当地的有利条件。多年来，该镇的劳动年龄居民纷纷离开，前往中国南方制造业中心广东的工厂寻找工作。其中包括郑传九，他最终在省会广州开始了自己的吉他制作业务。神曲吉他创始人告诉法新社：“当时公司经营得很好，我们在广州的大部分员工也是正安的老乡。” 2012年，正安当地政府推出了一项名为“凤凰还巢”的举措，鼓励熟练农民工返乡创业。 “县政府官员联系了我们。他们希望我们回来发展这个行业，”郑说。神曲成为第一家落户正安新经济区的吉他制造商。 “我在这里工作几年后，很多朋友看到我做得很好，就来这里和我一起发展这个行业，”他说。法新社7月访问神曲时，一排排成品吉他整齐地摆放在架子上，等待装运前的最后调音检查。 “既然家是最好的地方，为什么还要去很远的地方工作呢？”工厂里的横幅上写着。天然优势 近10年间，产业集群涌现出87个本土品牌。当局以全面的财务、税收和就业支持计划来吸引企业——其中一些企业获得了三年免税和十年免租的优惠。但重要的是，正安有着天然的优势。该地区的气候非常适合吉他制作，制琴大师张伟一于 2019 年将自己的生意从广州搬迁到这里。“无论这个行业是大还是小，...

reflection.en: The town of Zheng'an has transformed itself into a global hub for guitar production, a testament to focused effort and skilled craftsmanship. This dedication to producing quality instruments, from a town with no prior industry, echoes the biblical call to 'whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.' It's a...
reflection.zh: 郑安县已将自己转变为全球吉他生产中心，这证明了专注的努力和熟练的工艺。这个曾经没有任何产业的城镇，如今致力于生产高质量的乐器，这呼应了圣经的呼召：“无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是为主做的，不像为人做的。” 它提醒我们，在日常工作中勤奋和卓越可以荣耀神。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: In an era of extreme summers, it’s time to look beyond air conditioning
title.zh: 在极端夏天的时代，是时候超越空调了

summary.en: The Labour Department recently upgraded its Heat Stress at Work Warning system, making it easier for higher-tier alerts to be sent out, so that employers and workers, especially those who have to work outdoors, can react quickly during very hot weather. Unfortunately, the most we seem to be able to do is issue...
summary.zh: 劳工处最近升级了其工作暑热警告系统，使发出更高级别的警报更加容易，以便雇主和工人，特别是那些必须在户外工作的人，在酷热天气期间能够迅速作出反应。不幸的是，我们似乎只能发出警告并建议采取被动的缓解措施，例如调整工作时间表、在阴凉处休息和保持水分。随着气温一年比一年达到高峰，我们似乎只能坐以待毙。

body.en: The Labour Department recently upgraded its Heat Stress at Work Warning system, making it easier for higher-tier alerts to be sent out, so that employers and workers, especially those who have to work outdoors, can react quickly during very hot weather. Unfortunately, the most we seem to be able to do is issue warnings and recommend passive mitigation measures such as relaxing the work schedule, resting in the shade and staying hydrated. We are sitting ducks as temperatures peak year after...
body.zh: 劳工处最近升级了工作热应激警报系统，更容易发出更高级别的警报，以便雇主和工人，特别是那些必须在户外工作的人，可以在炎热的天气里迅速做出反应。不幸的是，我们似乎能做的最多就是发出警告并建议采取被动缓解措施，例如放松工作时间表、在阴凉处休息和保持水分。随着年复一年气温达到顶峰，我们如坐以待毙……

reflection.en: As temperatures soar and outdoor workers face increasing heat stress, the feeling of being overwhelmed and exhausted is palpable. This passage reminds us that even in the face of relentless environmental challenges, there is a divine promise of renewed strength. For those who feel their energy draining away under the oppressive heat, looking to Yahweh...
reflection.zh: 随着气温飙升，户外工作者面临日益严重的中暑风险，那种不堪重负和筋疲力尽的感觉是显而易见的。这段经文提醒我们，即使面对无情的环境挑战，雅伟也应许赐予我们新的力量。对于那些在酷热下感到精力耗尽的人来说，仰望雅伟能带来如鹰一般，超越眼前挣扎而展翅高飞的希望。

verse.textEn: Those who hope in Yahweh will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary.
verse.textZh: 但那等候雅伟的，必从新得力。他们必如鹰展翅上腾。

title.en: Why Chelsea football shirts are making Hong Kong fans nervous about crypto laws
title.zh: 切尔西球衣上的加密货币赞助让香港球迷对加密货币法律感到担忧

summary.en: Hong Kong fans and retailers are worried that Chelsea FC's new sponsorship deal with a stablecoin issuer might violate digital currency laws, potentially making it illegal to wear or sell the team's jerseys featuring the brand.
summary.zh: 香港的球迷和零售商担心切尔西足球俱乐部与一家稳定币发行商的新赞助协议可能违反数字货币法律，使得穿着或销售印有该品牌球衣成为非法行为。

body.en: English Premier League football club Chelsea’s lucrative new front-of-shirt sponsorship deal with a stablecoin issuer has left Hong Kong fans and retailers concerned about whether wearing or selling the top counts as illegal promotion under digital currency laws. Chelsea signed the deal with Circle to feature its USDC stablecoin brand on player jerseys for the 2026-27 season in late August, just three months after the UK’s Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) warned Premier League clubs about...
body.zh: 英超足球俱乐部切尔西与一家稳定币发行机构达成了利润丰厚的新球衣胸前赞助协议，这让香港球迷和零售商担心，根据数字货币法，穿着或出售球衣是否构成非法促销。 8 月下旬，切尔西与 Circle 签署协议，在 2026-27 赛季的球员球衣上展示其 USDC 稳定币品牌，而就在三个月前，英国金融行为监管局 (FCA) 向英超俱乐部发出警告……

reflection.en: The allure of lucrative sponsorships, like Chelsea's deal with a stablecoin issuer, can sometimes overshadow ethical considerations and legal boundaries. The love of money, as the Bible warns, can lead people astray and create complex situations where even fans might inadvertently break laws.
reflection.zh: 像切尔西与稳定币发行商的交易一样，诱人的赞助合同有时会掩盖道德考量和法律界限。正如圣经所警告的，对金钱的贪爱会使人迷失方向，并制造出复杂的局面，甚至让球迷也可能无意中触犯法律。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Gen Z is turning filial piety into a career path
title.zh: Z世代将孝道变成职业道路

summary.en: Hong Kong's traditional life formula for young people—study hard, get a job, work harder, buy a flat—is losing its appeal to Generation Z. This generation is exploring new concepts like 'full-time children' in mainland China, where young adults receive an allowance for household chores, indicating a shift in values...
summary.zh: 香港年轻人的人生传统公式——努力学习，找工作，更努力地工作，买房——正逐渐失去Z世代的吸引力。这一代人正在探索新的概念，例如中国大陆的“全职子女”，即年轻人领取津贴以换取家务劳动，这表明价值观和职业抱负发生了转变。

body.en: Hong Kong has always had a simple answer to what young people should do with their lives: study hard, get a job, work harder, buy a flat and eventually complain about the next generation. That formula is becoming harder to sell. A whole lexicon has grown up around Generation Z’s uneasy relationship with work. In mainland China, there are “full-time children”, young adults who stay home and receive an allowance from their parents in return for doing household chores and running errands....
body.zh: 对于年轻人应该做什么，香港一直有一个简单的答案：努力学习、找工作、努力工作、买房，最后抱怨下一代。这个公式正变得越来越难卖。围绕 Z 世代与工作之间不稳定的关系已经形成了一整套词典。在中国大陆，存在着“全职儿童”，即留在家里并从父母那里领取零用钱以换取做家务和跑腿的年轻人......

reflection.en: The pressures of modern life in Hong Kong seem to be leading Generation Z to question the established path of relentless work and material accumulation. The emergence of concepts like 'full-time children' suggests a search for different forms of value and security. In times of uncertainty about the future, the promise that Yahweh has plans for welfare and...
reflection.zh: 香港现代生活的压力似乎正促使Z世代质疑一成不变的辛勤工作和物质积累的道路。诸如“全职子女”等概念的出现，暗示着对不同形式价值和保障的寻求。在对未来感到不确定的时刻，雅伟关于祂的计划是为平安而非灾祸，要赐予你们盼望和未来的应许，提供了一个深刻的锚点。

verse.textEn: For I know the plans I have for you, declares Yahweh, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.
verse.textZh: 我知道我向你们所怀的意念，是赐平安的意念，不是降灾祸的意念，要叫你们末后有指望。这是雅伟说的。

title.en: Students in SARs set for live lecture from space
title.zh: 香港学生将有机会收看太空直播讲座

summary.en: Students and teachers in Hong Kong and Macao will soon have the opportunity to watch live scientific experiments from the three Shenzhou-23 astronauts currently aboard the Tiangong Space Station, including Hong Kong's first astronaut Lai Ka-ying. This "Tiangong Class" activity is described as a valuable aerospace...
summary.zh: 香港和澳门的学生及教师将很快有机会观看目前在天宫空间站的三名神舟23号宇航员进行的现场科学实验直播，其中包括香港首位宇航员赖嘉颖。此次“天宫课堂”活动被描述为一项宝贵的太空科学教育活动。

body.en: Students and teachers in Hong Kong and Macao will soon have the opportunity to watch live scientific experiments from the three Shenzhou-23 astronauts currently aboard the Tiangong Space Station, including Hong Kong's first astronaut Lai Ka-ying. In an announcement on Saturday, an HKSAR government spokesman said the "Tiangong Class" Hong Kong and Macao Designated Session will be a valuable aerospace science education activity for students conducted in the unique environment of space. The "Tiangong Class" activity, jointly organised by the Hong Kong SAR Government, the Macao SAR Government, and the China Manned Space Agency, includes an expert lecture, an in-orbit demonstration and a student question-and-answer session. The Education Bureau will arrange for teachers and students in primary and secondary schools to watch the live broadcast on campuses on the day of the event. The 'Tiangong Class' Hong Kong and Macao Designated Session builds a bridge for learning and exploration connecting Earth and space, guiding young people in Hong Kong and Macao to gain a deeper understanding of the remarkable achievements of the country's manned space development, the spokesman said. Live broadcast of the event will be made available online on multiple government websites, including the Information Services Department's website, the news.gov.hk Facebook page, as well as the "A Shared Cosmic Vision for National Rejuvenation" thematic website. In addition, Radio Television Hong Kong and other local television stations will also arrange live broadcasts. Edited by Azam Khan
body.zh: 港澳师生很快将有机会观看目前在天宫空间站的三名神舟二十三号航天员的科学实验现场，其中包括香港首位航天员黎嘉英。香港特区政府发言人周六在公告中表示，“天宫班”港澳专场将是在太空独特环境下为学生进行的一次有价值的航天科普教育活动。 “天宫课堂”活动由香港特别行政区政府、澳门特别行政区政府和中国载人航天工程局联合举办，内容包括专家讲座、在轨演示和学生问答环节。教育局将于活动当天安排中小学师生到校园观看直播。发言人表示，“天宫班”港澳专场搭建了连接地球和太空的学习探索桥梁，引导港澳青少年更深入地了解国家载人航天发展的卓越成就。活动将于多个政府网站进行网上直播，包括政府新闻处网站、政府新闻网Facebook专页，以及“民族复兴共享宇宙愿景”专题网站。此外，香港电台及其他本地电视台也将安排现场直播。阿扎姆·汗编辑

reflection.en: The vastness of space and the ingenuity of human exploration can inspire awe. As students witness experiments from the Tiangong Space Station, they are reminded of the incredible scale of creation and the human capacity to explore it. It is a moment to ponder our place in the cosmos, a place Yahweh has so wonderfully designed.
reflection.zh: 太空的浩瀚和人类探索的智慧能激发敬畏之心。当学生们观看天宫空间站的实验直播时，他们会被提醒受造界的宏大规模以及人类探索它的能力。这是一个思考我们在宇宙中位置的时刻，一个雅伟如此奇妙地设计的居所。

verse.textEn: What is mankind that you are mindful of them, human beings that you care for them?
verse.textZh: 人算什么，你竟顾念他？

title.en: HK's first robot-run store draws curious shoppers
title.zh: 香港首家机器人运营商店吸引好奇顾客

summary.en: Hong Kong's first robot-operated convenience stores attracted curious shoppers on Saturday. Locals interacted with a humanoid shopkeeper, chatting with it in multiple languages and watching it dance. The stores, launched by Beijing-based Galbot, are operated by its G1 robot, a 173-cm-tall humanoid designed for retail...
summary.zh: 香港首家机器人运营的便利店于周六吸引了好奇的顾客。当地人与一位人形店员互动，用多种语言与它交谈，并观看它跳舞。这些由北京Galbot公司推出的商店由其G1机器人运营，这是一款身高173厘米、专为零售任务设计的人形机器人，提供24小时零食和饮料。这款名为“小盖”的机器人会说普通话、粤语和英语，标志着Galbot首次在中国...

body.en: Hong Kong's first robot-operated convenience stores drew curious shoppers on Saturday, as locals interacted with a humanoid shopkeeper, chatted with it in multiple languages and watched it dance. Beijing-based embodied-intelligence robotics company Galbot launched three outlets in the city, operated by its G1 robot, a 173-cm-tall humanoid designed for retail tasks. The stores, which run 24 hours a day, offer snacks and drinks. The robot, known as Xiaogai, speaks Mandarin, Cantonese and English. Galbot already operates about 200 retail stores across nearly 50 cities on the mainland. The SAR outlets mark its first expansion outside the mainland. The experience intrigued shoppers, including local resident Dylan Tyack, who found it entertaining. “I've been to the mainland quite a bit and had the robot coffee makers and stuff. That's pretty cool. So I think this is a really unique concept, a good idea for Hong Kong, you know? Quite a fun experience," Tyack said. "He sang for us, yeah, its good fun entertaining kind of thing with my daughter, so yeah, pretty fun. Quite surprising how far technology's come. And what we can be in five years time, it'll be interesting. So yeah, it's a cool, cool, cool experience.” However, another resident, Yvonne Lau, noted the technology still needs refinement. "Actually, in my mind it might be able to sing a lot of songs, but it turned out there are copyright issues, so it can't sing them," she said. "Also, I think it is a bit dumb, but it's really a good start. If there are some sudden or unexpected situations, I feel the robot would probably not know how to handle them.” (Reuters) Edited by Azam Khan
body.zh: 周六，香港第一家机器人经营的便利店吸引了好奇的购物者，当地人与人形店主互动，用多种语言与它聊天，并观看它跳舞。总部位于北京的实体智能机器人公司 Galbot 在该市开设了三个门店，由其 G1 机器人运营，G1 机器人是一个高 173 厘米的人形机器人，专为零售任务而设计。这些商店全天 24 小时营业，提供小吃和饮料。该机器人名为“小盖”，会说普通话、粤语和英语。 Galbot已在大陆近50个城市经营约200家零售店。特区分店标志着其首次向大陆以外地区扩张。这种体验引起了购物者的兴趣，其中包括当地居民迪伦·泰克（Dylan Tyack），他觉得这很有趣。 “我去过大陆很多次，买过机器人咖啡机之类的东西。这太酷了。所以我认为这是一个非常独特的概念，对香港来说是个好主意，你知道吗？相当有趣的体验，”泰克说。 “他为我们唱歌，是的，和我女儿一起唱歌很有趣，非常有趣。技术的进步令人惊讶。五年后我们能做到什么，这会很有趣。所以，是的，这是一次很酷、很酷、很酷的体验。”然而，另一位居民 Yvonne Lau 指出，这项技术仍然需要完善。 “实际上，在我看来它可能可以唱很多歌曲，但结果是存在版权问题，所以它不能唱，”她说。 “而且，我觉得这有点愚蠢，但这确实是一个好的开始。如果出现一些突发或意外的情况，我觉得机器人可能不知道如何处理。” （路透社）阿扎姆·汗编辑

reflection.en: The introduction of humanoid robots like 'Xiaogai' in Hong Kong's retail spaces sparks wonder and curiosity about the future of human-machine interaction. As we encounter increasingly sophisticated artificial intelligence, it is a timely reminder to reflect on what makes us uniquely human. Genesis 1:27 reminds us that humanity is created in the image of...
reflection.zh: 香港零售业引入“小盖”这样的人形机器人，引发了人们对人机交互未来的好奇和惊叹。随着我们遇到日益复杂的人工智能，这是一个及时的提醒，让我们反思是什么使我们成为独特的人类。创世记1:27提醒我们，人类是按照雅伟的形象所造，这是一种深刻的尊严，使我们与众不同。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: China artists quit S.Korea art show after organisers let ‘Taiwan’ be used in name of exhibition
title.zh: 中国艺术家因“台湾”参展名称退出韩国艺术展

summary.en: Chinese artists have withdrawn from a major South Korean art exhibition, the Gwangju Biennale, after organizers allowed the name "Taiwan" to be used in an exhibition title. This action has drawn criticism from China and highlights the ongoing political sensitivities surrounding cross-strait relations.
summary.zh: 中国艺术家已退出韩国光州双年展，原因是组织者允许在一场展览的名称中使用“台湾”一词。此举引发了中国的批评，并凸显了海峡两岸关系中持续存在的政治敏感性。

body.en: Chinese artists withdrew from a major South Korean art show after organisers allowed “Taiwan” to be used in the name of an exhibition, officials said Thursday, as China issued a rebuke. Gwangju Biennale. Photo: Gwangju Biennale. The Gwangju Biennale, one of Asia’s largest contemporary art events, is due to open Saturday, with its Pavilion Project bringing together artists from around the world at venues across the southwestern city. The dispute began after Taiwanese artists said organisers had initially agreed to call their exhibition the “Taiwan Pavilion”, but changed the name in June to “NTMoFA”, the acronym for Taiwan’s National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts. The change was made “without the consent of the participating team, and brutally erased Taiwan from the poster,” the artists said in a joint statement last month, accusing organisers of “political censorship”. China insists Taiwan is part of its territory and has threatened to use force to annex the self-ruled island of more than 23 million people. Last week, the Gwangju Biennale foundation reversed course and agreed to restore the name “Taiwan Pavilion”. Chinese artists then halted preparations for their own pavilion, and on Thursday, the Chinese artists announced they would formally withdraw, according to local media footage. A spokesperson for the foundation told AFP: “We have confirmation the Chinese artists are withdrawing from the biennale.” China’s consulate general in Gwangju said Biennale organisers “openly allowed the Taiwan region of China to participate in the exhibition using a name that is completely inconsistent with its status.” “This constitutes a serious violation of the One China principle,” it said, adding: “We once again urge the organisers of the Gwangju Biennale to immediately rectify their wrongdoing.” South Korea’s foreign ministry spoke up to calm the row, saying that the “government’s basic position regarding Taiwan remains unchanged”. Taiwan’s flag. Photo: Walid Berrazeg/HKFP. The ministry said the decision was made in the cultural and artistic sphere, and “is unrelated to the South Korean government’s position regarding Taiwan.” “We hope that this issue will not affect South Korea-China relations or exchanges and cooperation between the two countries,” they added.
body.zh: 官员周四表示，在组织者允许在展览名称中使用“台湾”一词后，中国艺术家退出了韩国的一场大型艺术展，中国对此予以谴责。光州双年展。照片：光州双年展。亚洲最大的当代艺术活动之一光州双年展将于周六开幕，其展馆项目将来自世界各地的艺术家聚集在这座西南部城市的各个场馆。争议始于台湾艺术家表示，主办方最初同意将他们的展览命名为“台湾馆”，但在六月将其名称改为“NTMoFA”，即台湾国立台湾美术馆的缩写。艺术家们在上个月的一份联合声明中表示，这一改变是“未经参赛团队同意的，并且残酷地将台湾从海报上抹掉”，并指责组织者进行“政治审查”。中国坚称台湾是其领土的一部分，并威胁要使用武力吞并这个拥有超过 2300 万人口的自治岛屿。上周，光州双年展基金会改变立场，同意恢复“台湾馆”名称。据当地媒体报道，中国艺术家随后停止了自己展馆的准备工作，周四，中国艺术家宣布正式退出。该基金会的发言人告诉法新社：“我们已确认中国艺术家将退出双年展。”中国驻光州总领事馆表示，双年展组织者“公然允许中国台湾地区使用与其地位完全不符的名称参加展览”。 “这严重违反了一个中国原则，”声明称，并补充说：“我们再次敦促光州双年展的组织者立即纠正错误行为。”韩国外交部发声平息争端，称“政府对台湾的基本立场没有改变”。台湾的国旗。照片：Walid Berrazeg/HKFP。韩国文化部表示，这一决定是在文化艺术领域做出的，“与韩国政府对台湾的立场无关”。他们补充说：“我们希望这个问题不会影响韩中关系或两国之间的交流与合作。”

reflection.en: The Gwangju Biennale dispute, where Chinese artists withdrew over the naming of a Taiwanese exhibition, illustrates how political sensitivities can disrupt cultural exchange. The desire for peace and harmonious relations, as urged in Romans 12:18, is challenged when nationalistic sentiments lead to withdrawal rather than dialogue.
reflection.zh: 光州双年展的争端，中国艺术家因台湾展览的命名问题而退出，说明了政治敏感性如何扰乱文化交流。罗马书12章18节所敦促的和平与和谐关系之愿望，在民族主义情绪导致退出而非对话时受到挑战。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: HKFP Lens: ‘Love at last sight’ – bidding farewell to Hong Kong’s modernist General Post Office after 50 years
title.zh: HKFP镜头：“最后的凝视之爱”——告别香港50年的现代主义邮政总局

summary.en: When Hong Kong's General Post Office was constructed in Central fifty years ago, conservationists lamented the demolition of the building it replaced. The former General Post Office was an architectural masterpiece of the Edwardian era, featuring grand archways and granite veranda pillars under a distinctive facade of...
summary.zh: 五十年前，当香港邮政总局在香港岛中环建成时，保育人士对它取代的旧建筑被拆毁感到惋惜。旧邮政总局是一座爱德华时代建筑的杰作，拥有宏伟的拱门和花岗岩门廊柱，以及独特的玫瑰色厦门砖外墙，这被认为是抵御南中国海岸风暴的耐用性标杆。邮政总局位于干诺道2号的底层入口。十多年前，香港历史博物馆前总馆长曾称赞它为“香港最美丽的建筑”。

body.en: When the General Post Office was built in Central half a century ago, conservationists mourned the loss of the building it replaced. Exterior of the General Post Office. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The old General Post Office was a marvel of Edwardian architecture: sweeping archways and granite veranda pillars beneath a distinctive façade of rose-coloured Amoy brick – the gold standard for durability on the storm-lashed South China coast. The GPO’s ground-floor entrance at 2 Connaught Place. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Just over a decade ago, the former chief curator of the Hong Kong Museum of History crowned it “Hong Kong’s most beautiful building” when it stood at the site of what is now World-Wide House. For others , its loss ranked alongside the demolition of the old Hong Kong Club as one of the greatest architectural crimes the city has committed against itself. Post Office Private Boxes on the second floor of the GPO. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. But fast-forward to 2026 and accolades are now pouring in for the much-maligned replacement structure. Ahead of its own demolition, the current modernist General Post Office, erected in 1976, is belatedly finding recognition as an icon of modern Hong Kong heritage. Service counters in the General Post Office. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Crouching just five storeys above the Central harbourfront – its planned stature stunted so as to preserve the sea view from Jardine House – the post office’s sharp lines and white concrete walls buck against its ornate predecessor. Customers queue in the main hall of the GPO. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Yet, in retrospect, it’s clear to see how these design choices reflected the society it was born into: one that, by the 1970s, prized simple, utilitarian structures that served a rapidly growing population first and foremost. In the headlong rush to modernise and develop, form followed function – and decoration was optional. Towers of parcels wait at a GPO counter. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. It’s not the first time a modern landmark has, with time, won the hearts of Hongkongers. A row of desks in the GPO. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The looming demise of the GPO’s erstwhile neighbour, Edinburgh Place Ferry Pier, sparked spirited protests and a sit-in by conservationists in 2006. Although they failed to protect the 1950s landmark, many saw the movement as a watershed moment that led to the localist movement and pro-democracy mobilisation of the 2010s. A stairwell inside the GPO. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. In North Point, efforts to save the mid-century State Theatre have been ongoing for a decade, with some hard-won concessions from the government and developers. A second-floor window in the GPO overlooks the Court of Final Appeal Building....
body.zh: 半个世纪前，当邮政总局在中环建成时，自然资源保护主义者对它所取代的建筑物的损失表示哀悼。邮政总局的外观。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。旧邮政总局是爱德华时代建筑的奇迹：宽阔的拱门和花岗岩阳台柱子位于独特的玫瑰色厦门砖外墙之下，这是暴风雨肆虐的华南海岸耐用性的黄金标准。 GPO 底层入口位于康诺特广场 2 号。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。就在十多年前，当它矗立在现在的环球大厦旧址时，香港历史博物馆前总馆长将其誉为“香港最美丽的建筑”。对于其他人来说，它的损失与拆除旧香港会一样，是这座城市对自己犯下的最大的建筑罪行之一。邮局私人信箱位于 GPO 二楼。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。但快进到 2026 年，备受诟病的替代结构获得的赞誉纷至沓来。建于 1976 年的现代主义风格的邮政总局在被拆除之前，后来才被认为是现代香港遗产的象征。邮政总局的服务柜台。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。邮局坐落在中环海滨上方仅五层楼高处，其规划的高度被限制，以保留怡和大厦的海景。邮局的锐利线条和白色混凝土墙与其华丽的前身形成鲜明对比。顾客在 GPO 大厅排队。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。然而，回想起来，我们可以清楚地看到这些设计选择如何反映了它诞生的社会：到了 20 世纪 70 年代，这个社会推崇简单、实用的结构，首先是为快速增长的人口服务。在现代化和发展的急速推进中，形式追随功能——装饰是可选的。 GPO 柜台前堆满了包裹。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。随着时间的推移，现代地标赢得了香港人的心，这并不是第一次。 GPO 中的一排办公桌。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 2006 年，GPO 的昔日邻居爱丁堡广场渡轮码头即将消亡，引发了自然资源保护主义者的激烈抗议和静坐。尽管他们未能保护 1950 年代的地标，但许多人认为这场运动是导致 2010 年代地方主义运动和民主动员的分水岭。 GPO 内的楼梯间。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。在北角，拯救中世纪国家剧院的努力已经持续了十年，政府和开发商做出了一些来之不易的让步。总督察署二楼的一扇窗户俯瞰着终审法院大楼……

reflection.en: For fifty years, the General Post Office building stood in Central, a landmark that has now reached the end of its public service life. The story notes the lament of conservationists for the beautiful Edwardian building it replaced, highlighting the passage of time and the inevitable changes that come with it. Ecclesiastes reminds us that 'there is a time...
reflection.zh: 五十年来，邮政总局大楼矗立在中环，如今它已走到了公众服务生涯的尽头。故事提到保育人士对它取代的爱德华时代美丽建筑的惋惜，突显了时间的流逝以及随之而来的不可避免的变化。《传道书》提醒我们，“凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时”，这是建筑物的兴衰和城市发展的变迁所体现的真理。

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verse.textZh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong, a young activist known for his role in Hong Kong's democracy movement, has pleaded guilty to charges under the national security law. This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Shein shares slide on fast-fashion retailer’s stock market debut
title.zh: Shein股票上市首日下跌，快时尚零售商估值缩水

summary.en: Shares of the fast-fashion brand Shein fell as much as 10% on their debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The company, founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, was valued at just over $26 billion, a significant drop from its previous valuation of nearly $100 billion.
summary.zh: 快时尚品牌Shein在香港证券交易所上市首日股价下跌高达10%。这家中国创立、现总部设在新加坡的公司，估值略高于260亿美元，远低于其此前近1000亿美元的估值。

body.en: Hong Kong flotation at $26bn by firm once valued at $100bn follows failure to list in US and UK Shares in the fast-fashion brand Shein slumped by as much as 10% as the China-founded company made its long-anticipated trading debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The Singapore-headquartered company, once valued at almost $100bn (£74bn), went public on Tuesday pricing shares at HK$48.56, valuing the business at just over $26bn. Continue reading...
body.zh: 曾估值 1000 亿美元的公司在香港发行 260 亿美元，此前该公司未能在美国和英国上市。快时尚品牌 Shein 在香港证券交易所首次上市后，其股价下跌了 10%。这家总部位于新加坡的公司一度估值近 1000 亿美元（740 亿英镑），周二上市，股价为 48.56 港元，业务估值略高于 260 亿美元。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic drop in Shein's valuation on its Hong Kong stock market debut, from nearly $100 billion to just over $26 billion, serves as a potent reminder of the volatile nature of commerce. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans, a wisdom that transcends market highs and lows.
reflection.zh: Shein在香港股市上市首日估值从近1000亿美元暴跌至略高于260亿美元，这有力地提醒我们商业的波动性。箴言16:3鼓励我们将所做的事交托给雅伟，信靠祂必成就我们的计划，这智慧超越了市场的起伏。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: A mysterious signal around Earth could be dark matter
title.zh: 地球周围的神秘信号可能是暗物质

summary.en: Scientists have utilized Earth's magnetic field and atmosphere as a planet-sized detector to investigate the lightest proposed forms of dark matter. This method has significantly improved limits on ultralight axions and revealed intriguing signals of dark photons that require further study.
summary.zh: 科学家利用地球的磁场和大气层作为行星大小的探测器，以寻找最轻的暗物质形式。这种方法大大提高了对超轻轴子的限制，并发现了几个有趣的暗光子信号，这些信号仍需进一步研究。

body.en:
Dark matter is one of the biggest unsolved mysteries in modern physics. Astronomers are highly confident that it exists and estimate that it accounts for about a quarter of the universe's total energy content, yet scientists still do not know what it is made of.

Two leading possibilities are hypothetical particles known as ultralight axions and dark photons . In the mass range examined by the researchers, these particles would be extraordinarily light, roughly 19 to 21 orders of magnitude lighter than an electron.

Many traditional axion experiments try to convert axions into photons by exposing them to extremely strong magnetic fields inside laboratories. The challenge is scale. Even powerful lab magnets can only cover a relatively small region.

Researchers from Kyoto University, Hiroshima University, and Nihon University saw a way around that limitation. Instead of relying only on laboratory equipment, they asked whether Earth's own magnetic environment could be used as part of the experiment.

"We asked ourselves whether we could use the Earth itself as a giant detector in the search," says corresponding author Atsushi Taruya. "The Earth-ionosphere cavity acts as a natural resonator that amplifies electromagnetic waves right around the mass range we wanted to probe."

The region between Earth's surface and the ionosphere can naturally resonate with electromagnetic waves, much like a large cavity. That made it especially useful for searching for signals associated with the ultralight particles the team wanted to investigate.

One obstacle was that previous theory could only reliably describe frequencies below 1 Hz. That left much of the potentially useful frequency range unexplored.

To solve this problem, the researchers developed a new theoretical framework that includes the electrical conductivity of the atmosphere. Their calculations showed that the Earth-ionosphere cavity can amplify signals near 8 Hz and allowed them to make reliable predictions up to about 30 Hz.

The model also predicted an important difference between the two dark matter candidates. Signals produced by axions should vary depending on location, with the strongest expected in Southeast Asia. Dark photon signals, by contrast, should appear at nearly the same strength around the world.

Using this framework, the team examined roughly 10 years of geomagnetic measurements collected between 2012 and 2022 by the British Geological Survey's Eskdalemuir Observatory.

The researchers first removed artificial sources of noise from the data. They then looked for the kind of steady signal concentrated within a very narrow frequency range that dark matter is expected to produce over long periods of time. The results were then subjected to statistical analysis.

The same theoretical...
body.zh: 暗物质是现代物理学中最大的未解之谜之一。天文学家对它的存在非常有信心，并估计它约占宇宙总能量的四分之一，但科学家仍然不知道它是由什么组成的。 两种主要的可能性是被称为超轻轴子和暗光子的假设粒子。在研究人员检查的质量范围内，这些粒子非常轻，大约比电子轻 19 到 21 个数量级。 许多传统的轴子实验试图通过将轴子暴露在实验室内极强的磁场中来将轴子转化为光子。挑战在于规模。即使是强大的实验室磁铁也只能覆盖相对较小的区域。 来自京都大学、广岛大学和日本大学的研究人员找到了解决这一限制的方法。他们并没有仅仅依赖实验室设备，而是询问是否可以使用地球自身的磁环境作为实验的一部分。 “我们问自己是否可以使用地球本身作为搜索中的巨型探测器，”通讯作者 Atsushi Taruya 说。 “地球电离层空腔充当天然谐振器，可以放大我们想要探测的质量范围附近的电磁波。” 地球表面和电离层之间的区域可以自然地与电磁波共振，就像一个大空腔。这使得它对于搜索与团队想要研究的超轻粒子相关的信号特别有用。 一个障碍是先前的理论只能可靠地描述 1 Hz 以下的频率。这使得许多潜在有用的频率范围未被探索。 为了解决这个问题，研究人员开发了一个新的理论框架，其中包括大气的电导率。他们的计算表明，地球电离层空腔可以放大接近 8 Hz 的信号，并使他们能够做出高达约 30 Hz 的可靠预测。 该模型还预测了两种暗物质候选者之间的重要差异。轴子产生的信号应该根据位置的不同而有所不同，预计东南亚的信号最强。相比之下，暗光子信号在世界各地应该以几乎相同的强度出现。 利用这个框架，研究小组检查了英国地质调查局埃斯克代尔缪尔天文台在 2012 年至 2022 年间收集的大约 10 年的地磁测量结果。 研究人员首先从数据中去除了人为噪声源。然后，他们寻找暗物质在很长一段时间内产生的集中在非常窄的频率范围内的稳定信号。然后对结果进行统计分析。 同样的理论...

reflection.en: The vastness of the universe and its many mysteries, like dark matter, invite us to explore and understand creation. As Job 12:7-9 reminds us, 'Ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds of the sky, and they will tell you... In all these the hand of Yahweh has done this.' The scientific endeavor to uncover these secrets is a way of observing the...
reflection.zh: 宇宙的浩瀚及其诸多奥秘，如暗物质，邀请我们去探索和理解受造界。正如约伯书12:7-9所提醒的：“你可以问走兽，它们会教导你；天空的飞鸟，它们会告诉你……这一切都是雅伟的手所做的。” 科学界揭示这些秘密的努力，正是观察造物主精妙作为的一种方式。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: 80,000-year-old “arrowheads” rewrite human history
title.zh: 8万年前的“箭头”改写人类历史

summary.en: Archaeologists have identified tiny 80,000-year-old projectile points in Uzbekistan that may have been used like arrowheads. Their size, design, and impact damage closely resemble weapons found much later at a Homo sapiens site in France. The discovery suggests sophisticated projectile technology may have appeared in...
summary.zh: 考古学家在乌兹别克斯坦发现了一些微小的、有8万年历史的投射点，它们可能被用作箭头。它们的尺寸、设计和撞击损伤与后来在法国的一个智人遗址发现的武器非常相似。这一发现表明，复杂的投射技术可能在中亚出现，远在现代人类在欧洲站稳脚跟之前，这可能会改写人类迁徙史上的一个重要篇章。

body.en: Archaeologists have identified tiny 80,000-year-old projectile points in Uzbekistan that may have been used like arrowheads. Their size, design, and impact damage closely resemble weapons found much later at a Homo sapiens site in France. The discovery suggests sophisticated projectile technology may have appeared in Central Asia long before modern humans became firmly established in Europe, potentially rewriting a major chapter of human migration.
body.zh: 考古学家在乌兹别克斯坦发现了具有 8 万年历史的微小射弹点，这些射弹点可能被用作箭头。它们的尺寸、设计和冲击损伤与很久以后在法国智人遗址发现的武器非常相似。这一发现表明，复杂的射弹技术可能早在现代人类在欧洲站稳脚跟之前就已经出现在中亚，这有可能改写人类迁徙的重要篇章。

reflection.en: The discovery of these ancient projectile points in Uzbekistan is a testament to the ingenuity that has characterized humanity throughout its history. It reminds us that wisdom and skill are not solely modern inventions, but have deep roots, observable even in the remnants of our earliest ancestors. As we uncover more about our past, we see the unfolding of...
reflection.zh: 在乌兹别克斯坦发现这些古老的投射点，证明了贯穿人类历史的创造力。它提醒我们，智慧和技能并非现代的发明，而是有着深厚的根源，即使在我们最早祖先的遗迹中也能观察到。随着我们对过去的了解越来越多，我们看到了雅伟创造的展开，以及祂赋予我们的非凡能力。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Aviation faces hotter, stormier skies – and passengers might have to accept more disruption
title.zh: 航空业面临更炎热、风暴更频繁的天空——乘客可能不得不接受更多延误和干扰

summary.en: Are people going to have to increasingly accept more delays and diversions as the effects of climate change intensify?
summary.zh: 随着气候变化的影响加剧，人们是否将不得不越来越多地接受更多的延误和改航？

body.en:
As the country sweltered through one of the many heatwaves of a baking summer in late June, towering thunderclouds were gathering over the south of England and across much of northern Europe. It was a Saturday, and with the holiday season getting under way, thousands of passengers were heading to London's Heathrow and Gatwick airports to catch flights abroad. It was always going to be a very busy day.

What followed, however, was chaos for travellers. As air traffic controllers struggled to route aircraft around the storms, airspace became heavily congested and many planes due to fly were simply forced to wait on the ground. In the end, some 900 flights to and from both airports were delayed, some by up to 11 hours. Dozens more were cancelled. At airports across Europe, passengers expecting to fly into London also faced long waits and uncertainty.

The weather in the UK may now have cooled, and passengers may soon forget their experiences. But some within the industry believe what happened in June should be seen as a warning.

The timing in this case was clearly unlucky. But there are concerns that such incidents are only going to become more common as the effects of climate change mount up around the world and weather systems are likely to become increasingly unstable, making disruption more likely and adding to costs for airlines, airports and travellers.

Tim Atkinson, an airline risk consultant and former pilot, says the very crowded skies over the UK and northern Europe mean the region is particularly exposed.

He thinks there is a real risk, for example, that all of London's airports could be affected by storms at the same time, potentially with major consequences in the air and on the ground.

"We're going from the kind of weather activity which takes out an airport, and which the system kind of copes with… to a situation where, with very little predictability, it would be possible to lose all of the London airports from real-time operation quite swiftly and with little notice".

Such a scenario, he thinks, would make the disruption for passengers caused by the incident in June seem relatively minor – and could even put lives at risk. But how likely is it?

For controllers at National Air Traffic Services's (NATS) main control centre in Swanwick, Hampshire, thunderstorms are a major preoccupation. When I visit, it is a hot and humid day, there are ominous dark clouds in the sky, and heavy, thundery downpours are hitting the surrounding region.

In Terminal Control, the part of the building responsible for flights heading to or from airports in London and southern England, those same storm cells are being monitored continually. Their progress is tracked on large radar screens, while at the same time weather forecasts are carefully...
body.zh: 六月下旬，当这个国家经历了炎热夏季的众多热浪之一时，高耸的雷雨云正在英格兰南部和北欧大部分地区聚集。那是一个星期六，随着假期的到来，成千上万的乘客前往伦敦希思罗机场和盖特威克机场搭乘国外航班。这总是非常忙碌的一天。 然而，随之而来的是旅客的混乱。由于空中交通管制员努力引导飞机绕过风暴，空域变得严重拥堵，许多原定飞行的飞机被迫在地面等待。最终，大约 900 架次往返这两个机场的航班均被延误，有的延误长达 11 小时。还有数十个被取消。在欧洲各地的机场，预计飞往伦敦的乘客也面临着漫长的等待和不确定性。 英国的天气现在可能已经变冷，乘客可能很快就会忘记他们的经历。但一些业内人士认为，6月份发生的事情应该被视为一个警告。 这起案件的时机显然很不走运。但有人担心，随着气候变化的影响在世界各地加剧，天气系统可能变得越来越不稳定，此类事件只会变得更加普遍，从而更有可能造成干扰，并增加航空公司、机场和旅客的成本。 航空公司风险顾问兼前飞行员蒂姆·阿特金森表示，英国和北欧上空非常拥挤，意味着该地区尤其容易受到影响。 例如，他认为存在真正的风险，伦敦所有机场可能同时受到风暴影响，可能对空中和地面造成重大影响。 “我们正在从那种导致机场瘫痪、系统需要应对的天气活动转变为这样一种情况：在几乎没有可预测性的情况下，所有伦敦机场有可能在几乎没有通知的情况下很快就失去实时运行的能力”。 他认为，这种情况会使 6 月份的事件对乘客造成的干扰显得相对较小，甚至可能危及生命。但这种可能性有多大呢？ 对于位于汉普郡斯旺威克的国家空中交通服务 (NATS) 主控制中心的管制员来说，雷暴是他们最关心的问题。我去的时候，天气炎热潮湿，天空乌云密布，周围地区还​​下着倾盆大雨。 在航站楼控制中心（负责往返伦敦和英格兰南部机场的航班的大楼部分），这些风暴单元正在受到持续监控。他们的进展在大型雷达屏幕上被追踪，同时天气预报也被仔细地......

reflection.en: The recent chaos at Heathrow and Gatwick airports, with nearly 900 flights delayed due to severe thunderstorms, illustrates how climate change intensifies natural disruptions. As Psalm 46:1 reminds us, 'God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.' In times of unpredictable weather and travel chaos, this offers a perspective of divine...
reflection.zh: 近期在希思罗和盖特威克机场因严重雷暴天气导致近900个航班延误的混乱场面，说明了气候变化如何加剧了自然界的干扰。正如诗篇46:1所提醒我们的：“神是我们的避难所，是力量，是患难中随时的帮助。” 在不可预测的天气和旅行混乱时期，这提供了一种在地上动荡不安中，神同在和最终保障的视角。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: This “new” frog was hiding in plain sight for 100 years
title.zh: 这只“新”青蛙已“藏匿”了100年

summary.en: A common frog species found across Ecuador and Colombia has been officially recognized as its own species, Pristimantis milpe, after more than a century of being mistaken for another. Museum specimens from the 1800s were crucial in helping scientists make this distinction.
summary.zh: 一种在厄瓜多尔和哥伦比亚广泛分布的常见青蛙，在被误认为另一个物种一个多世纪后，终于被正式确认为独立的物种，名为Pristimantis milpe。科学家们利用19世纪的博物馆标本帮助做出了这一区分。

body.en:
Scientists at the Pontificia Universidad Católica del Ecuador have formally described Pristimantis milpe , a common and widespread frog that spent more than a century being mistaken for another species. The mystery was resolved by studying specimens collected in Ecuador during the 19th century and preserved at the Natural History Museum in London.

The finding stands out because many newly described species are rare or confined to small areas. Pristimantis milpe , by contrast, is widespread, relatively easy to find, and readily detected by its nighttime call. Its known range covers more than 67,000 square kilometers across the Chocó forests of western Ecuador and southern Colombia, from sea level to elevations of 1,200 meters.

The formal description appears in the international journal ZooKeys , which focuses on biodiversity and taxonomy.

Researchers were able to identify Pristimantis milpe by revisiting historical amphibian specimens housed at the Natural History Museum in London (NHM).

Santiago Ron, a researcher at PUCE and lead author of the study, traveled to England to investigate a classification problem that had persisted for more than 100 years. He examined the original specimens - known as "types" - that had been collected in Ecuador during the 19th century and preserved in the museum ever since.

By comparing those historical frogs with living populations from the Ecuadorian Chocó, the team found that the old specimens had been incorrectly linked to a different species. As a result, a frog that had been regularly seen and documented for decades never received a scientific name of its own.

"That such a common species has gone unnoticed under the wrong name for decades highlights the importance of correctly connecting scientific names with living populations in nature," notes Jhael Ortega, a PhD student at Virginia Tech and one of the study authors.

The Milpe Robber Frog ( Cutín de Milpe ) is active at night. Males typically call from leaves on shrubs and bromeliads several meters above the forest floor. Their calls are loud and distinctive, producing a sound similar to a "click."

Females and males also differ noticeably in appearance. Females have striking coloration around the groin and thighs, where orange or light blue tones can appear alongside black spots. Males generally have more uniform coloring.

The frog lives in the forests of the Ecuadorian Chocó and southern Colombia, a region considered especially important for biodiversity conservation.

The discovery highlights the continuing scientific importance of natural history collections. Specimens preserved for decades or even centuries can give researchers a way to revisit old classifications, compare physical traits, and resolve questions...
body.zh: 厄瓜多尔天主教大学的科学家正式描述了Pristimantis milpe，这是一种常见且分布广泛的青蛙，一个多世纪以来一直被误认为是另一个物种。通过研究 19 世纪在厄瓜多尔收集并保存在伦敦自然历史博物馆的标本，这个谜团得以解开。 这一发现之所以引人注目，是因为许多新描述的物种都很罕见或仅限于小区域。相比之下，Pristimantis milpe 分布广泛，相对容易发现，并且很容易通过其夜间叫声被发现。其已知分布范围覆盖厄瓜多尔西部和哥伦比亚南部的乔科森林，面积超过 67,000 平方公里，从海平面到海拔 1,200 米。 正式的描述出现在国际期刊 ZooKeys 上，该期刊重点关注生物多样性和分类学。 研究人员通过重新审视伦敦自然历史博物馆（NHM）收藏的历史两栖动物标本，能够识别出Pristimantis milpe。 PUCE 研究员、该研究的主要作者圣地亚哥·罗恩 (Santiago Ron) 前往英国调查一个持续了 100 多年的分类问题。他检查了 19 世纪在厄瓜多尔收集的原始标本（称为“类型”），此后一直保存在博物馆中。 通过将这些历史上的青蛙与厄瓜多尔乔科青蛙的现存种群进行比较，研究小组发现旧的标本被错误地与不同的物种联系起来。结果，几十年来经常被看到和记录的青蛙从未获得自己的科学名称。 弗吉尼亚理工大学的博士生、该研究的作者之一贾埃尔·奥尔特加 (Jhael Ortega) 指出：“几十年来，这样一个常见的物种一直以错误的名称未被注意到，这凸显了将学名与自然界中的现存种群正确联系起来的重要性。” 米尔佩强盗蛙（Cutín de Milpe）在夜间活跃。雄性通常从森林地面上方几米的灌木和凤梨科植物的叶子上发出叫声。它们的叫声响亮而独特，发出类似于“咔哒”的声音。 女性和男性在外观上也有明显差异。雌性腹股沟和大腿周围有引人注目的颜色，橙色或浅蓝色色调可以出现在黑点旁边。雄性通常有更均匀的颜色。 这种青蛙生活在厄瓜多尔乔科和哥伦比亚南部的森林中，该地区被认为对生物多样性保护特别重要。 这一发现凸显了自然历史收藏的持续科学重要性。保存数十年甚至数百年的标本可以为研究人员提供一种重新审视旧分类、比较身体特征并解决问题的方法……

reflection.en: The natural world continues to reveal its wonders, even after centuries. The formal description of Pristimantis milpe reminds us of the vast, intricate biodiversity Yahweh has created, much of which remains to be discovered and understood. It is a testament to the Creator's wisdom that such complexity exists, often hidden in plain sight.
reflection.zh: 大自然持续揭示其奇迹，即使历经数个世纪。Pristimantis milpe 的正式描述提醒我们，雅伟创造了多么浩瀚而复杂的生物多样性，其中许多仍有待发现和理解。如此复杂的生命形式，常常就隐藏在我们眼前，这是造物主智慧的明证。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Breaking through AlphaFold's limits to predict how proteins change shape
title.zh: 突破AlphaFold的局限性，预测蛋白质如何改变形状

summary.en: Conformational changes in proteins are vital to their function yet remain challenging for state-of-the-art artificial intelligence, such as AlphaFold3, to predict. Researchers at the Institute for Molecular Science (IMS), and the Graduate University for Advanced Studies, SOKENDAI introduced a repulsive force between...
summary.zh: 蛋白质的构象变化对其功能至关重要，但对于像AlphaFold3这样的最先进人工智能来说，预测这些变化仍然具有挑战性。分子科学研究所（IMS）和高等研究生院大学SOKENDAI的研究人员在预测结构之间引入了排斥力，使AlphaFold3能够采样其默认设置很少捕获的多种构象状态。

body.en: Conformational changes in proteins are vital to their function yet remain challenging for state-of-the-art artificial intelligence, such as AlphaFold3, to predict. Researchers at the Institute for Molecular Science (IMS), and the Graduate University for Advanced Studies, SOKENDAI introduced a repulsive force between predicted structures, allowing AlphaFold3 to sample the multiple conformational states that its default settings rarely capture.
body.zh: 蛋白质的构象变化对其功能至关重要，但对于 AlphaFold3 等最先进的人工智能来说，预测仍然具有挑战性。分子科学研究所 (IMS) 和高级研究大学 SOKENDAI 的研究人员在预测结构之间引入了排斥力，使 AlphaFold3 能够对默认设置很少捕获的多种构象状态进行采样。

reflection.en: The intricate dance of proteins, their ability to shift and change shape, is a marvel of biological engineering. Scientists, through dedicated research and innovative methods, are peeling back layers of this complexity. This pursuit of understanding the 'how' of life's machinery reflects a deep human impulse to explore the wonders of creation, finding...
reflection.zh: 蛋白质的复杂舞蹈，它们改变形状的能力，是生物工程的奇迹。科学家们通过专注的研究和创新的方法，正在揭开这种复杂性的层层面纱。这种对生命机制“如何运作”的理解追求，反映了人类探索造物之奇的深层冲动，并在其精密的构造中找到智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: How much clearcutting can nature sustain? A study determines the ecological limit for boreal forest birds
title.zh: 大片采伐对北方森林鸟类的影响有多大？一项研究确定了生态极限

summary.en: A study by the University of Jyväskylä in Finland has, for the first time, established an ecological threshold for the extent of clearcutting in boreal forests. The findings indicate that preserving bird species specialized in old-growth forests necessitates either an average forest rotation period of at least 90...
summary.zh: 一项由芬兰于韦斯屈莱大学牵头进行的研究，首次评估了北方森林采伐量的生态阈值。研究结果表明，要维持以原始森林为生的特有鸟类种群，平均需要至少90年的森林轮伐期，或者将约五分之一的森林面积排除在皆伐管理之外。该研究为森林的生态可持续利用提供了具体目标。

body.en: A study led by the University of Jyväskylä in Finland evaluated, for the first time, an ecological threshold for the amount of clearcutting in boreal forests. According to the results, maintaining populations of bird species specialized in old-growth forests requires either a forest rotation period of at least 90 years on average or that approximately one-fifth of the forest area be excluded from clearcut management. The study provides a concrete target for the ecologically sustainable use of forests.
body.zh: 芬兰于韦斯屈莱大学领导的一项研究首次评估了北方森林砍伐量的生态阈值。根据结果​​，维持专门生活在古老森林中的鸟类种群需要平均至少 90 年的森林轮作期，或者将大约五分之一的森林面积排除在砍伐管理之外。该研究为森林的生态可持续利用提供了具体目标。

reflection.en: The intricate balance of ecosystems, as explored in this study of boreal forests and their bird populations, reflects the profound wisdom woven into creation. The Psalmist marvels, 'How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.' This research helps us understand and respect the delicate systems Yahweh has...
reflection.zh: 这项关于北方森林及其鸟类种群的研究，揭示了生态系统的复杂平衡，这反映了雅伟编织进受造界的深邃智慧。诗人惊叹道：“雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！万物都凭你的智慧而造；全地充满了你的造物。”这项研究帮助我们理解并尊重雅伟所设立的精妙系统。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: FAST finds two mysterious hydrogen clouds with no visible stars
title.zh: FAST发现两团无可见恒星的神秘氢云

summary.en: Astronomers using China's FAST radio telescope have detected two large clouds of hydrogen gas near the Whirlpool galaxy. Each cloud contains approximately 3 million times the mass of the sun in hydrogen but lacks any detectable stars or optical counterparts, presenting a puzzle for current cosmological models.
summary.zh: 天文学家使用中国的FAST射电望远镜在旋涡星系附近探测到两团巨大的氢气云。每团云的氢气质量约为太阳的300万倍，但却没有任何可探测到的恒星或光学对应体，这给当前的宇宙学模型带来了谜团。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Astronomers have found two clouds of hydrogen near the Whirlpool galaxy that appear to contain almost no stars. The clouds, discovered with China's FAST radio telescope, each contain roughly 3 million times the mass of the sun in hydrogen but have no detectable optical counterpart. Their properties are outlined in a new paper published in the Astronomy & Astrophysics journal on Aug. 4.

According to the standard Lambda Cold Dark Matter (LCDM) model of the universe, structure forms hierarchically: Small dark-matter halos form first, then merge to build larger halos and galaxies. But not every dark-matter halo is expected to become a galaxy because several processes can suppress star formation at sufficiently low masses.

If a halo's gravitational potential is weak, stars may not form. If the gas is not dense and cold enough, it cannot collapse into stars. Gas may be heated by the ultraviolet (UV) background, which is made up of diffuse radiation from quasars and stars throughout the universe. This leads to a population of dark-matter halos containing neutral hydrogen gas but few or no stars.

In this work, led by Qingze Chen of the National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences, researchers tested this idea: a small dark-matter halo that retained some gas after cosmic reionization but whose gas never became cold and dense enough to form stars because it was heated by UV radiation. They call it the reionization-limited H I cloud, or RELHIC.

To be classified as a RELHIC, a surviving hydrogen cloud should be compact, roughly spherical, show narrow spectral lines with velocities around 20 kilometers per second (km/s), and have no stellar component detected at optical wavelengths. LCDM predicts a huge population of low-mass dark-matter halos. So far, only a handful of such starless clouds have been identified.

The researchers searched for 21-cm radio wavelength signals—telltale signatures of neutral hydrogen (H I). They used H I observations from the Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical Telescope (FAST), specifically the FEASTS survey.

They analyzed 55 galaxies in the FEASTS sample to identify objects meeting the conditions for hydrogen clouds. Only two objects—Cloud N and Cloud S—in the entire sample passed the criteria.

Both have a hydrogen mass of roughly 3 million solar masses and a total halo mass of 3.7 billion solar masses. This large ratio between gas mass and total halo mass closely matches theoretical predictions for such systems. "They are both compatible with the RELHIC framework," the team writes in the paper.

Interestingly, both lie around...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 天文学家在漩涡星系附近发现了两片氢云，它们似乎几乎不包含恒星。这些云是用中国的FAST射电望远镜发现的，每个云中都含有质量约为太阳300万倍的氢，但没有可探测到的光学对应物。 8 月 4 日发表在《天文学与天体物理学》杂志上的一篇新论文概述了它们的特性。 根据宇宙的标准 Lambda 冷暗物质 (LCDM) 模型，结构是分层形成的：首先形成小型暗物质晕，然后合并形成更大的晕和星系。但并不是每个暗物质晕都有望成为星系，因为有几个过程可以抑制质量足够低的恒星形成。 如果光环的引力势弱，恒星可能不会形成。如果气体密度不够、温度不够，就无法塌缩成恒星。气体可能会被紫外线（UV）背景加热，紫外线背景由来自整个宇宙的类星体和恒星的漫射辐射组成。这导致了暗物质晕的聚集，其中含有中性氢气，但很少或没有恒星。 在中国科学院国家天文台陈庆泽领导的这项工作中，研究人员测试了这个想法：一个小型暗物质晕在宇宙再电离后保留了一些气体，但其气体永远不会变得足够冷和稠密以形成恒星，因为它被紫外线辐射加热。他们称之为再电离限制 H I 云，或 RELHIC。 要被归类为 RELHIC，幸存的氢云应该是致密的，大致呈球形，显示出狭窄的光谱线，速度约为每秒 20 公里 (km/s)，并且在光学波长下没有检测到恒星成分。 LCDM 预测存在大量低质量暗物质晕。到目前为止，只有少数这样的无星云被识别出来。 研究人员寻找 21 厘米无线电波长信号——中性氢 (H I) 的明显特征。他们使用了 500 米孔径球面望远镜 (FAST) 的 H I 观测结果，特别是 FEASTS 巡天观测。 他们分析了 FEASTS 样本中的 55 个星系，以确定满足氢云条件的天体。整个样本中只有两个物体——云 N 和云 S——通过了标准。 两者的氢质量约为 300 万太阳质量，晕总质量为 37 亿太阳质量。气体质量与晕环总质量之间的巨大比率与此类系统的理论预测非常吻合。 “它们都与 RELHIC 框架兼容，”该团队在论文中写道。 有趣的是，两者都躺在...

reflection.en: The discovery of these immense, starless hydrogen clouds challenges our understanding of cosmic structure. It reminds us that the universe holds profound mysteries, vast beyond our current comprehension. Like the psalmist, we can look to the heavens and be filled with awe at the sheer scale and intricate design of creation, recognizing that Yahweh's glory...
reflection.zh: 发现这些巨大的、无恒星的氢云挑战了我们对宇宙结构的理解。它提醒我们，宇宙充满了我们目前无法完全理解的深邃奥秘。就像诗篇作者一样，我们可以仰望星空，对创造的浩瀚规模和精妙设计感到敬畏，并认识到雅伟的荣耀在寂静的宇宙中得以彰显。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Flourishing green communities are changing lives
title.zh: 蓬勃发展的绿色社区正在改变生活

summary.en: Four projects have been nominated in the environmental category in Devon's Make a Difference Awards for their work in making communities more eco-friendly, wilder, and healthier through activities like planting trees, growing vegetables, and leading nature exploration.
summary.zh: 在德文郡的“做出改变奖”环保类别中，有四个项目因其在使社区更环保、更野性、更健康方面所做的工作而获得提名，这些项目通过植树、种植蔬菜和组织自然探索等活动来达成目标。

body.en:
Four projects have been nominated in the environmental category in BBC Radio Devon's Make a Difference Awards.

The Growing Well Garden in Bow, the Sampford Peverell Tree Wardens in mid-Devon, Shallowford Farm on Dartmoor, and Sustainable Hatherleigh are being recognised for making their communities more eco-friendly, wilder and healthier.

They are doing this in a range of ways from planting trees and growing vegetables, to leading bug hunts and rediscovering nature.

The winners of the Make a Difference awards are due to be announced on 24 September at Buckfast Abbey.

Growing Well Garden is part of a green social prescribing project, where gardening is used as a therapeutic tool and helps a doctor connect with her patients in a different way.

Dr Susan Taheri is an NHS GP at Bow Medical Practice and the founder of Growing Well Garden project - she said the scheme reignited her passion for being a GP.

She said meeting patients in a garden can have benefits compared to seeing them a consulting room and describes the garden as her "happy place".

"There's a lot more getting your hands dirty and not worrying too much about germs," she said.

Retired horticulturalist Charles Staniland's love for the outdoors started in early childhood and he now volunteers there, teaching young people to get their hands dirty.

He said he wanted to show a more physical approach to food, that it doesn't just show up on a plate, and that it's something they can contribute to.

Staniland hopes the project can "encourage a new generation to understand and value the world around them".

"It takes people out of a concrete environment - it's a very good first step into a greener environment," he said.

Sampford Peverell Tree Wardens are an independent, environmentally-focused, volunteer based group which takes care of the parish's greenery.

For Pete Drew and the other wardens, looking after the environment is a community effort, often powered by cake.

The group plants, protects and maintains trees and hedges on publicly owned land, working with councils and landowners.

He said it was about "taking pride in where you live and making local spaces better for everyone".

Sustainable Hatherleigh runs a range of projects to support the community, from leading bug hunts and encouraging wildflowers and biodiversity in the local graveyard to community composting and running a repair café.

Their site in the middle of the town has now been recognised as a county wildlife site.

Jo Pullin and Sustainable Hatherleigh hope to create a resilient future for the area.

Jo Pullin from Sustainable Hatherleigh, Dr Susan Taheri from Growing Well Garden, Charles Staniland from Shallowford Farm and Pete Drew from Sampford Tree Wardens are finalists in the awards.

body.zh: 四个项目已获得 BBC 德文郡电台“Make a Difference Awards”环境类别提名。 Bow 的 Growing Well Garden、德文郡中部的 Sampford Peverell Tree Wardens、Dartmoor 的 Shallowford Farm 和 Sustainable Hatherleigh 因使社区变得更加环保、更加狂野和健康而受到认可。 他们通过多种方式做到这一点，从植树和种植蔬菜，到领导昆虫狩猎和重新发现自然。 Make a Difference 奖的获奖者将于 9 月 24 日在巴克法斯特修道院公布。 Growing Well Garden 是绿色社会处方项目的一部分，其中园艺被用作治疗工具，帮助医生以不同的方式与患者建立联系。 Susan Taheri 博士是 Bow Medical Practice 的 NHS 全科医生，也是 Growing Well Garden 项目的创始人 - 她说该计划重新点燃了她成为全科医生的热情。 她说，与在咨询室见到病人相比，在花园里会见病人更有好处，并将花园描述为她的“快乐的地方”。 “还有很多事情会弄脏你的双手，而且不用太担心细菌，”她说。 退休园艺家查尔斯·斯坦尼兰 (Charles Staniland) 从童年时期就开始热爱户外活动，现在他在那里做志愿者，教导年轻人要亲自动手。 他说他想展示一种更实际的食物处理方式，食物不仅仅出现在盘子上，而且这是他们可以做出的贡献。 斯坦尼兰希望该项目能够“鼓励新一代了解和重视他们周围的世界”。 “它让人们脱离了具体的环境——这是迈向绿色环境的非常好的第一步，”他说。 Sampford Peverell 树木管理员是一个独立、注重环保、以志愿者为基础的团体，负责照顾教区的绿化。 对于皮特·德鲁和其他狱长来说，保护环境是一项社区努力，通常由蛋糕提供动力。 该组织与议会和土地所有者合作，在公有土地上种植、保护和维护树木和树篱。 他说这是为了“为自己居住的地方感到自豪，并让当地空间对每个人来说都变得更好”。 可持续哈瑟利开展了一系列项目来支持社区，从领导昆虫狩猎、鼓励当地墓地种植野花和生物多样性，到社区堆肥和经营修理咖啡馆。 他们位于镇中心的地点现已被认定为县野生动物保护区。 乔·普林 (Jo Pullin) 和可持续哈瑟利 (Sustainable Hatherleigh) 希望为该地区创造一个充满活力的未来。 来自 Sustainable Hatherleigh 的 Jo Pullin、来自 Growing Well Garden 的 Susan Taheri 博士、来自 Shallowford Farm 的 Charles Staniland 和来自 Sampford Tree Wardens 的 Pete Drew 入围该奖项。 在 X 上关注 BBC Devon，...

reflection.en: The nomination of these four projects in Devon celebrates the tangible impact of community-led environmental initiatives. It echoes the Genesis account where Yahweh surveyed all that was made and declared it 'very good.' These efforts remind us that tending to the earth, growing food, and fostering wild spaces are acts that honor this original goodness.
reflection.zh: 德文郡这四个项目的提名，是对社区主导的环境倡议所产生的切实影响的庆祝。这呼应了《创世记》中雅伟审视他所造的一切，并宣告其“甚好”的记载。这些努力提醒我们，照料大地、种植食物和培育野外空间，都是荣耀这最初美善之举。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Trump signs order to remove endangered species protection for grey wolves
title.zh: 特朗普签署命令，取消灰狼濒危物种保护

summary.en: The US president says the move will help ranchers, but conservationists say it could derail efforts to recover populations. The executive order removes endangered species protection for the grey wolf and the Mexican wolf, potentially allowing ranchers to kill them to protect livestock, despite conservation groups'...
summary.zh: 美国总统称此举将有助于牧场主，但环保人士表示这可能会破坏种群恢复的努力。该行政命令取消了灰狼和墨西哥狼的濒危物种保护，可能允许牧场主为保护牲畜而杀死它们，尽管环保团体担心这会影响长期的种群恢复工作。

body.en:
Donald Trump has signed an executive order to remove endangered species protection for the grey wolf and a subspecies, the Mexican wolf.

The US president's decision could pave the way for pastoral farmers to kill the canines to protect their livestock. His order said ranchers played a "vital role" in the food supply chain and American cultural heritage.

But conservation groups have criticised the move, saying it could derail long-term efforts to recover the endangered wolf populations.

There were 319 Mexican wolves in the wild in the US in 2025, up from just four when they were reintroduced in 1998, US Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS) figures show.

Meanwhile, there are roughly 18,000 grey wolves across the US, though they are still considered endangered as most of their habitat has been destroyed by humans.

An attempt to de-list them at a federal level in 2022 became tied up in litigation, and some campaigners have indicated they intend to do the same of the US Department of Interior acts on Trump's order.

The executive order does not give ranchers immediate license to shoot wolves preying on livestock, but instead gives Interior Secretary Doug Burgum 90 days to determine whether the grey and Mexican wolf populations had recovered enough to warrant being taken off the endangered species list.

Noting that US livestock herds were at a 75-year low while demand for beef had risen by 10% in the past decade, the order added: "More can and should be done to support this critical industry."

However, environmental groups pointed to studies that suggested wolf attacks on livestock were rare and had little impact on ranchers' income.

"This is a huge distraction to placate a handful of ranchers and make them believe that wolves are a greater threat than President Trump's own policies," said Greta Anderson, deputy director of Western Watersheds Project, which works to conserve wildlife in western US states.

The Wolf Conservation Center noted that ranchers were entitled to up to 100% compensation for any livestock losses caused by wolves under the current system, with individual states providing funding for programmes to deter attacks.

"The Mexican grey wolf is not recovered simply because the population has grown," said Claire Musser, executive director of the Grand Canyon Wolf Recovery Project. "Weakening federal protections now would put decades of recovery work at risk."

The executive order comes as the Trump administration is seeking to lower record-high beef prices for consumers, driven by drought and an outbreak of parasites in US beef stocks.

Ranchers have been frustrated by Trump's decision to loosen restrictions on beef imports to address price rises, putting pressure on their already tight margins.
